Peter ,
This weekend, Americans in every corner of the country will take part in peaceful “No Kings” rallies – a reminder that we’re a democracy, not a dictatorship.
But Speaker Mike Johnson and Trump’s MAGA allies are already trying to smear it. They’re calling it a “hate-America rally,” and even comparing attendees to actual terrorists.
But Mike Johnson and Trump know exactly what they’re doing. The GOP’s coordinated attack on these rallies is meant to scare people into silence, to make standing up for democracy sound like some radical act.
It’s not.
Standing up for the rule of law, for free speech, for the simple idea that no one – not even Donald Trump – is above the people... that’s the most American thing any of us can do.
If you believe in We the People – not One King – chip in now to power our turnout operations in Pennsylvania, New Jersey, and Virginia this November. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/gotvpacemq2?refcode=Email10162025]

I want to share the momentum we're already seeing this election cycle:

We just won in New Orleans! **Helena Moreno** has been elected mayor, earning 55% of the vote in a field of multiple strong contenders and avoiding a runoff entirely. This is a historic win. She will be the city's first Latina mayor!

This past week, two of our gubernatorial candidates, **Mikie Sherrill (NJ)** and **Abigail Spanberger (VA)** , shined in their respective debates. They demonstrated exactly what strong, capable leadership looks like. Watching them handle tough questions with grace and grit was inspiring.

Here's the thing: In two weeks, we have the opportunity to elect Mikie and Abigail as the chief executives of these two key states. But beyond that, we also have the opportunity to send a message to Republicans that we're not backing down — we're going to win races in 2025, 2026, and beyond that help us take back power across the country.

But none of that happens without you. You've helped EMILYs List grow into the largest resource for women in politics — and your support is what keeps this momentum alive when it matters most.

name: Katie Porter
subject: Why I’m running for governor
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Katie Porter for Governor 2026
body:
My story is such an important part of who I am today.
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/21486?t=1&akid=40276%2E3422442%2EYZntrb)
Dear Peter,
My story is such an important part of who I am today, and why I’ve dedicated my career in public service to fighting for people who get left behind or taken advantage of by the system.
I want to tell you more about my story, but first: **[I’m running for governor of California to lower costs and make life easier for all of us. If you’re with me, I hope you can pitch in $5 to my campaign today.](https://act.katieporter.com/go/21531?c0=em_ms_kp_20251016_1_ak.gy1bjk&refcode=em20251016-40276&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=40276%2E3422442%2EYZntrb)**
I grew up in rural Iowa, where my parents, two siblings, and I lived in a two-bedroom, one-bath house. My father was a farmer and my mother was a small business owner.
As I grew older, I saw neighbors and friends lose everything as Iowa’s economy collapsed during the farm crisis of the 1980s. That experience shaped how I see the economy, which is set up to bail out the rich and powerful while working Americans are left behind.
I got scholarships to attend good schools, but I was reminded that other students came from different backgrounds and didn’t have to work multiple jobs through college. **Ever since then, I’ve never forgotten my roots growing up.**
I decided to go to law school because I knew I wanted to pursue a career that would help people. While in school, I had the opportunity to study under then professor Elizabeth Warren. She helped me see **the power of strong consumer protections—and how clear rules give families a fair shot.**
I carried these lessons to California, where I was raising my three young children and teaching law when then Attorney General of California Kamala Harris asked me to serve as the California Monitor of the National Mortgage Settlement. **I held the Big Banks’ feet to the fire, delivering billions in relief for homeowners and helping thousands of families stay in their homes.**
**That fight prepared me for one of the most important points of my life: my decision to run for Congress.** In the middle of Trump’s first term, I saw firsthand how he was handing the keys to the economy over to his rich and powerful friends. Working families were getting left behind while he gave huge tax breaks to billionaires.
**I ran in a district that was a decades-long Republican stronghold and won—because voters knew I would fight for them, not special interests.** In Congress, I used my power to fight for the same values I had my entire career: making life easier for working families, women, and people that are far too often forgotten in Washington.
I know what it’s like for most Californians right now. Unlike many of my peers in Congress, I didn’t have to rely on talking points to tell me what ordinary people were going through. I’m a single mom raising three kids—I know the struggle. I stretch my grocery dollars with coupons, shop second-hand for dresses for the campaign trail, and worry about the high costs that add up when my 2010 minivan needs a repair. These are the same challenges so many Californians face, and that perspective matters—it’s why I fight the way I do.
**Now, I feel the same call to serve that I did in 2018.** Donald Trump is out of control, costs in California are crushing families, our housing crisis is decades in the making, and health insurance premiums are going up thanks to Trump’s chaos in Washington. I could go on, but the point is something has to change.
**As governor, I’ll fight to bring down costs, make housing more affordable, and hold big oil, big pharma, and big banks accountable when they cheat Californians.** I’ll make sure our state works for everyone—not just the wealthy and well connected.
**[But I won’t be able to do these things without you, Peter. Can you pitch in $5 to help us win and make California work for everyone?](https://act.katieporter.com/go/21531?c0=em_ms_kp_20251016_1_ak.gy1bjk&refcode=em20251016-40276&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=40276%2E3422442%2EYZntrb)**
[Donate ›››](https://act.katieporter.com/go/21531?c0=em_ms_kp_20251016_1_ak.gy1bjk&refcode=em20251016-40276&t=23&akid=40276%2E3422442%2EYZntrb)
Thank you,
Katie Porter

Katie is running to be California’s next governor because California and our country need a leader who will stand up to Trump to lower costs, protect our rights, and combat climate change. **[Donate ›››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4g-em-footer?refcode=em20251016-40276&amounts=&t=24&refcode2=40276_3422442_YZntrb&akid=40276%2E3422442%2EYZntrb)**

Shortly after Trump returned to office this year, I started a series exploring the impacts of his policies on the economy. The [first installment](https://substack.com/redirect/79af2ca4-94b0-4790-8c73-d05197316c5f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) examined his tariffs and the supply chain, collapsing foreign tourism, the impacts of ham-fisted immigration enforcement on vulnerable industries that depend on immigrant labor, and the impacts on aggregate demand of firing public workers by the tens of thousands.
The [second post](https://substack.com/redirect/543eb29f-29b0-4cc2-a63c-8edc1feff018?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in the series went on to analyze consumer confidence, asset valuation bubbles in the real estate and housing markets, and several examples of crumbling economic infrastructure, from the U.S. Postal Service and Federal Aviation Administration to Social Security.
This post continues the analysis, in light of events since this spring, starting with the ninth way in which this administration's policies continue to lay waste to the American economy...

name: Rep.-elect Adelita Grijalva (via Democrats.org)
subject: Republicans refuse to swear me in:
body:
---
Derek, you may not know who I am, and that’s understandable. My name is Representative-elect Adelita Grijalva. **Arizonans elected me to Congress _three weeks ago_ , but Speaker Johnson is refusing to swear me in. ** This isn’t normal. The three other representatives elected this year were literally sworn in less than 24 hours after their elections, even when the House wasn’t meeting. But me? I’m here in Washington, ready to work and ready to add one more crucial vote against Republicans’ slim majority. That’s undoubtedly why Speaker Johnson will not swear me in. Derek, this affront to democracy makes clear how critical it is to elect Democrats to fight back. We need to take back the House, yes, so that Speaker Johnson can’t continue to play these games, but we also need to elect Democratic governors, secretaries of state, and state legislators to protect free, unobstructed elections. And the DNC is doing this work to elect Democrats up and down the ballot, nationwide. **High school dropout. Waffle House waitress. First woman to graduate from The Citadel. Single mom. Fighter.** **Nancy Mace wasn’t born into power. She worked for every inch of ground she’s gained.** At 17, she dropped out of high school and took a job slinging hash browns at Waffle House to survive. No silver spoon. No Ivy League connections. Just grit, grace, and a whole lot of graveyard shifts. **By the grace of God, she turned that struggle into a story no politician can touch.** She made history as the first woman to graduate from The Citadel, South Carolina’s legendary military college. She built her own business. She raised two kids on her own. And when the Left came for everything she believed in, she stood her ground.Now, she’s running for Governor of South Carolina. Nancy Mace is a battle-tested conservative who’s walked through fire and come out swinging. In Congress, she’s been one of President Trump’s fiercest allies, fighting to secure our border, protect our daughters, and stop the Left’s sick agenda dead in its tracks. **She’s not here to make friends. She’s here to make history.** Nancy is fighting to:
* Eliminate South Carolina’s Income Tax—the highest in the Southeast
* Prosecute violent criminals and pedophiles with zero leniency
* Crack down on sanctuary sheriffs who let illegal aliens roam free
* Defund radical public universities that indoctrinate, not educate
* Reform education so students learn how to think—not what to think
* Work hand-in-hand with President Trump to put South Carolina FIRST

Through every hardship, Nancy never gave up. And now she’s ready to do what she’s always done: roll up her sleeves, take the heat, and lead from the front. **South Carolina is worth fighting for. And Nancy Mace is just getting started.**

**Dear MAHA Warriors,** From lowering drug prices to ending harmful animal testing, the MAHA movement continues to prove that when people demand change, Washington listens. This week, we held our biggest and most important Media Hub yet. >From mental health to ending vaccine mandates and the absurdity of giving newborns the Hep B vaccine — just about every major MAHA topic was discussed. More than 8,000 people joined the call live, showing just how far this movement has come.
### If you missed it, don’t worry — here are a few of the key moments you need to know.
* **Dr. Rand Paul** spoke about how forcing the COVID and Hep B vaccines is not supported by science and how parents deserve honest information before making decisions.

* **Dr. Joseph Ladapo** , Florida’s Surgeon General, emphasized the importance of bodily autonomy and the right to choose what goes into your body or your child’s.

* **Dr. Drew Pinsky** reminded us that medicine can save lives but should never replace purpose, work, and healthy living.

* **Cooper Davis** and **Laura Delano** shared how our system focuses on prescribing drugs instead of actually helping people who are struggling with mental health.

Each person spoke about a different issue, all equally important to the shared goal of making America healthier.

### 2\. Keep Calling About the Pesticide Liability Shield
Congress is drafting a Farm Bill that would hand pesticide companies liability protection and block states from setting their own safety rules. We’ve talked about this before, but this fight isn’t over. **If we stop calling, Big Chem wins.** [Here is a walkthrough with phone numbers and a sample script on The Pesticide Liability Shield from Glyphosate Facts.](https://www.mahaaction.com/r?u=4OpapyABMkIfQDTWg-zeF1CJdpObTKtVmaXukLMCcFCZt9wfm40nHirBIOLzwowyxDa7GuFPL7iNBdLfZVEVXA&e=674c9b4e7ea0bed829630c80c355f23d&utm_source=maha&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=media_hub_recap_251016_engage1&n=4)
### 3\. MAHA Is Taking On the Mental Health Crisis
We live in the most depressed and overmedicated society in history. MAHA is working to change that by shifting the conversation from prescriptions to real healing. It’s time to start addressing the root causes, not covering symptoms with pills. [Click here](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-e-qhklydt-hhlljjcji-k/) **For Immediate Release: ****Contact:** Gage Hoekstra, Press Secretary, **_[ghoekstra@indiana.gop](mailto:greid@indiana.gop)_****Indiana Defies National Trend: Governor Mike Braun 's Freedom and Opportunity Economic Policies Drive Growth While Others Stall**Indianapolis - A new Wall Street Journal MarketWatch report reveals that while 22 states are currently in recession and another 14 are merely treading water, Indiana stands out as one of the few states experiencing genuine economic expansion.Under the leadership of Governor Mike Braun, a Main Street Entrepreneur who built his business from the ground up, Indiana's economy continues to grow thanks to his Freedom and Opportunity Agenda: focused on lowering taxes, empowering small businesses, and making government more efficient."Governor Mike Braun campaigned on moving Indiana's economy to mirror the success of states like Florida and Texas, and due in part to his conservative economic solutions, Indiana is now one of the few states leading an economic expansion while much of the country remains stuck in recession," **said Indiana GOP Chairwoman Lana Keesling.** "This report reaffirms that Indiana is open for business, growing good-paying jobs, and proving that conservative leadership works."

**BACKGROUND ...

Are we in a recession? Yes -- if you live in one of these 22 states. **"The U.S. economy is very close to falling into a damaging contraction -- and many states are already experiencing a recession, according to Mark Zandi, chief economist at Moody's Analytics. Zandi estimates that 22 states plus the District of Columbia are now experiencing persistent economic weakness and job losses that are likely to continue. Another 13 states are treading water, he noted." | | Dear Friend, On September 10, 2025, Charlie Kirk -- husband, father, and founder of Turning Point USA -- was assassinated while speaking at Utah Valley University. His death was not only a personal tragedy but a deliberate attack on free speech, religious freedom, and the values that bind our Republic together. That's why **Christian Action Network** has drafted the **Charlie Kirk Memorial Resolution** , now under review in Congress. ## Trump, Putin To Meet in Hungary
President Trump and Russian President Vladimir Putin have [agreed to meet in Budapest](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DuO4zAMBuDTyB0DvfwqVGzjLttuacgRHXNHlgyLTuDbD5w5wjQEAYI_-PHffbx7ipSef_2Kjuc8JnyXiMy4j7wf67YdTGlFZErPKUfOidKopa5BSVDtGDzFc7RVcDOiRlOhU20jm762qqsWNxtjmnpG29azrSfEBusuGK1kNyE-QkXuSlNStUpKY-zN9HPXayul7R_NhL2wEgNx3m__MyVecI5nfuF-e-S1im5h3oowf4QehB7SueXC10jo4QoWelDyKo3Qw1Hg8gk9fGxQ_FlgQfApwAcKb4oRLi5QgukIfsPy01MAzoApwPG1e0oIb78LPVS7C9u1RqVphZXP1VP83Ma_eujL6e8AAAD__4MzikU) to discuss ending the war in Ukraine, following a lengthy call between the two leaders. Secretary of State Marco Rubio will lead a U.S. delegation in preliminary talks with Russian officials next week. The summit date hasn’t been announced, but it will follow [Trump’s scheduled meeting](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL3OnDAURJ_GdKDrH-x14SIN3aZNiQxcLzcxNjJm0b59xL7C10wz0hmd-fMcn54ipddvv6GrIY8JryNirVjGWs5t389KaUOslF5TjjUnSqMA0bccWm7GxVP8jKpZXEAUKBt03GjQtlf80axO2FmaSYMyGHqz-EXKYOxkA6AFqfuG3E3jwA0HkFJ10oaHFQpA2VlPaJkCXKjm0v3NlOqKIX7yG0s3562Jbq11P5j8xcTAxHBdVzenab5LJoYbzcTA4Q7NxPB1ar9SbTmPg3x7_iueEnZr3WJT3LJfFCMd2jAFr81T_A7VH73zduJ_AAAA__-Abnf7) today at the White House with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky. The U.S. is weighing whether to give long-range Tomahawk missiles to Ukraine, a threat Russia has strongly criticized. Trump said “great progress” was made in the Putin call.
## Outdoor Retailers Closing Stores
The [outdoor retail sector is undergoing](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0D1uxCAUBODT4I4VYPxDQZHG3aZNaWHzWBNhngXPa-3to42UE6T9itHMfN3nu4sp5sen28FSwDnDVRMQQZmpnPtxnBTzDkAxPxZMhDnmWQnVcSm4HGbvYnrNuvE2AChoG7By6EVvOi3HZrMCuq4fw7Ku0hg3LKvTWvbeDdANnXZ9E-07TQo5SCHaVt9aE0ajtBDarP0ChmkBPhKW2zfGTBuE9MInlNuKe5PsRnRU1n4wNTE1XZd_O1NTQKQLXOHvRUxNdUPgMfuzUnn9IZ7kEQsvQC4mfhRcEuyVr5jruUPh9cBClZMrMQReCQtULlU7KiPkKJiammL9ccWUYu0HpsVjdzH9dqN_Hfq06icAAP__ZReMiQ) a major shakeup as legacy brands like REI and Orvis close stores and restructure operations in response to overexpansion, changing consumer behavior, and mounting trade pressures. [REI will close](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLuynDAQRL8GMlF68QoUONnsOnVICTRaxhYSpRku3r937f6Csw66uvqcX1_Ll8eE-fnTH-A4liXDTQmYoS5cr-M8L8Z8ADDm51oSl4x50VL3QkmhxiV4TK_FtsFFAA2mBafGQQ5zb9XU7s5KrdapN30c1nUCA5tety1YE-MUtDItuveakmpUUhpjOzPHadZWSjtvwwpzYyUE5FK73wUz7xDTq3xD7bZytMntzCc15kejH41-3PfdxfJ3vQgzEL07jX5UYI_pE1BsqRAI3iuAyKXyDp5YEJcKJLTUg_DBn0yCdoxvbHH4-geYxHYRlwOqyACBRIWzVG6rC-eNKSENY2Pl8_CYPt_4v4R-O_0vAAD__ylAjn0) its flagship SoHo store in New York along with locations in Boston and Paramus, New Jersey, by late 2026, while Orvis plans to shutter 36 stores, nearly half its U.S. footprint, citing problems caused by tariffs. Both companies, once [buoyed by the pandemic-era outdoor boom](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2y3CAMRp8Gd-yIn4WlcJHG3U2b0sO1ha0MBg-w6_HbZ8gr3EaNpCOd78_X_OUpUtp--wPHFvKc8KoRW8Myt_I-zvPdKB2IjdL2nWPLidIsQT65AC7svHqK96yHdQyIEtWAo7AGjHtq8Rr20Ri7WOfE6p3V8FLO-icGpQEgeBn8QGOnCRBWACilH8qFl5MaQLvFfKNjGnCllsvjb6bUdgzxzh8sjyUfQxz31s7K1C8mJyan67oe7-pbXv3dB5icasvlZnLqZkxO_RqTk4BeTF_Zb17PXLoh33JeK192T4nn8qHKqfIl5tqbCX2JN999DJxa5Z2MnfkyViplDIBlchrKuJ4XxUjVWKZhOzzF_9-2H0X8GeW_AAAA__9qCI60), are now contending with declining foot traffic, bloated inventories, and younger consumers shifting toward hybrid social fitness trends, such as running clubs, pickleball, and obstacle races.
## Ranking: America’s Fastest-Growing States
U.S. population growth is projected to be [concentrated in the South and West](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGuozAQRb8GOtDYODgULrahy7Zbook9kFkZG9mToPz9U_ILr7-6R-f8uy035Mhp-4s7OVnzkuiskUSoLFKe-3E8hdNOJJy2e46SE6dFg750Cjpll4Ac34tpg1uJNA0tOWVHGKeLUdf24YyZANHTAPaq_ErjeLfBWuODIRxUaNl93hQoqwCGwfTDtF4nbQDM5Mc7TY0BCiy59P8zJ3nQGt_5RaX3eW-je4gctRn-NHpu9HyeZ__i-sTo8WDByFU-w0bPuFNhj7VbsQpV6baST05bVwWFaveV0nCBRs9tceE4OUauo20MbDty_ALlV5VeTv8EAAD___GIfME) between 2025 and 2050, driven by internal migration, according to a new analysis. Texas is forecast to see the largest absolute growth, gaining 8.6 million residents, while Utah is predicted to be the fastest-growing state by percentage, increasing its population by 35% over the coming 25 years. Overall, national growth is projected to be 9%, or roughly 32 million more people between now and 2050. The Southwestern shift continues a trend as states like Illinois and Pennsylvania are projected to see a population loss. Overall, 18 states are expected to lose population, led by West Virginia's projected 15% decline. subject: Riedel Campaign October Update

body:
| | | | |
---
Riedel Campaign Update | October 17, 2025
---
Riedel Issues Statement on President Trump
---
|
---
| "Blessed are the peacemakers!"

This past week, President Trump was able to broker a historic peace agreement in the Middle East. Where some say it can't be done, the President continues to work on resolving conflicts all throughout the world in the name of American prosperity. The Trump Administration continues to lead with the principle of peace through strength on the world stage.
"Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called children of God." (Matthew 5:9, NIV)
---
|
---
Craig Attends GOP Banquets Across the District Every fall, local county Republican parties host dinners and banquets. These events give voters the chance to hear directly from GOP candidates and elected officials about their vision and accomplishments. Over the past month, Craig has attended the Henry County Fall Dinner, Hardin County Colonel's Club Dinner, Putnam County Lincoln Reagan Dinner, and the Paulding County Fall Banquet. Each of these events was headlined by Gubernatorial candidate Vivek Ramaswamy. Craig was thrilled to share the stage with Mr. Ramaswamy, where they both laid out their positive vision for a more prosperous Ohio.
---
| | |
---
|
---
| | |
---
| |
---
| Riedel Campaign Fundraiser on Indian Lake
This month, Steve and Debbie Terrill hosted a Riedel Campaign fundraiser at their home on Indian Lake. Craig and Danette were extremely grateful and encouraged from the support received from both Logan and Hardin Counties at the event.
---
|
---
| |
---
| |
---
| | Door-to-Door Campaign in Full Swing
The Riedel campaign has made it a priority to meet and talk with as many voters as possible over the course of the campaign. Door knocking has been a crucial part of that mission. Craig and Danette find time to be out knocking doors almost everyday, making connections and hearing from constituents all across the 1st Senate District.
---
| | |
---
| |
---
|
# Parade and Festival Season Continues

As parade season begins to come to a close, Craig and Danette are thankful for the opportunity to visit communities all across the 1st Senate District to celebrate what makes each city or town unique. This past month, Craig and Danette took part in the Ada Harvest and Herb Festival Parade and the Continental Fall Fest Parade.
---
| |
---

---
| |
---

---
| |
---

---
| |
---
| Upcoming Van Wert Fundraiser
The Riedel campaign will be having a fundraiser next month in Van Wert. The event will be held at R Place Stone Grill in downtown Van Wert from 5:30pm-7:30pm on Monday, November 10. Craig is encouraged by the support that he has already received for the event, and looks forward to seeing new and familiar faces.

**Good Morning!** On this day in 1957, professional football player and wrestler [Steve McMichael](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0L9yrCAUgPGnwW4dDiJiQXEbO2-TIiXDn-N6Jqw6QHT37TObV0j5Nb_i-5zt7CjRdv_vHmjqc9nthldJWCtmW47vXFzGzUU6KWI594q5BGcFF_0N-A0GGx2ll5VNNJ7HERo0MCiuRq01NKsRegQndIdCS-E9-h68lmpQXvWiW_qGzBsDDgMABxjaMMoYtFOdXHrpw8gkx0h1z21dseLTlSW99hNzG_ZHk8xa61FY94-JiYkJt_aiLzowkmv3fGdiejcT00fFE-0cZgqrw9RkE4-LUqKiBib5_eEo_ZL1byNOI34CAAD__yazcpY) was born in Houston. Nicknamed "Mongo" and "Ming the Merciless," he played defensive tackle at UT Austin and was a member of the Chicago Bears team that won Super Bowl XX. He was inducted into the College Football Hall of Fame in 2010 and the Pro Football Hall of Fame in 2024. McMichael passed away in April. Texas is projected to gain 8.6 million new residents by 2050, accounting for more than a quarter of the nation's anticipated population growth, [according to forecasts](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2uozAQRp8GOpDta4wpXGxDl223RBN7ICOZH3kmkLz9KnmF23_6js75d5tuQJm25S-sGOQ179OGF2cUwTLx8SwMBTdIdFJCPnfBwhEmo0zXaNXofkpA-T3ZOoW7SoOuMejeKTd473X9CM6mQTvfofe2V7Fz3qPvtB_UfUYTu5rC50wr3WuttO7bONgUPbgfO3f2HofKKkwke2nlgYIv4Dm_9xNLG_e1zuEhcnD186cyY2XG67rak_gJOcJBAplYPsPKjLBioQjczMCCLM1S9ou2pWEBQW6-UkZ1qjJjXUI6LsqZ2PWVVcsKlL9A-V2mM5j_AQAA__8xmnzc) from the University of Virginia. ## Dallas Turns Down $25M ICE Offer
The city of Dallas [turned down a $25 million offer](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2u3CAUhJ8Gd2cFmD8XFGnc3bQprWM4vouEzQq49u7bR84rpByNvtHM_PlavjDldHz_xp18f29lOehqmXqnurTXT21Y6cCYzhSpnaVTbQEXyaUGwUHYJWLKn0UN0a88TmIgL6zhZnLOieHpcYxutSMftVJCmzBqLYV1HDVNRsRpSP4OE1xYIbgQ9hEmFYNDM6pNqzVMTHGKqZf66E_q9Ma25U85qT5C2Yfsn72_Ght_MTkzOV_X9bg2xNtkcsbaU8jE5HzvYnIONe23jJgzNniVnAJBeCbaoOGnQf-pB0WI5TpAathTzqkcEAkzpHCj0lkYHa1SIQejuQMVHMEa5ArShG2VLhqHZqg-vq6bb8Yyxb93TPlf6f5_V59e_g0AAP__EMmQzA) from U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement to partner with the agency in enforcing immigration laws. Dallas Police Chief Daniel Comeaux revealed during a Tuesday meeting of the Community Police Oversight Board that he made the unilateral decision. Participating in the 287(g) program would have authorized police officers to inquire about the immigration status of detainees and provided federal reimbursement for salaries and operational costs. Earlier this month, the Department of Homeland Security announced it would [fully reimburse](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2urCAUhZ8GOwwwKlpQ3MZubntKs4XtSIJgYKszb3_ivMJpVrWyfr6f5_QEH3x8_YcNDb2XNEW8SkAizFPZj1wgYwTnT--wnIkwFwuTEqrlUnCpJwc-fKamcmYWbpAVGqk70Q1938tqNRqdsIPoNMp-bsE1iAKUUGrRS6vmrvLmDpNCaimFlLq2Q-NsD92jWdpmtgNrBDpPKde0IuEbyhI-6cRc27RVwaxEe2GPf0yNTI3XddVuLfUrnUyN9xmmxruBqVEMtyimRrcWDjGmI1osPOLFM_ptPnLBDSPxtO8p0xE9eSy8EBByiI6HZCHwABfHuKRsv-4qG7dfPgRfOs0a8drAh-84-hvS06jfAAAA__8ho41b) the salary and benefits of officers participating in the program. Comeaux did not [provide a rationale](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLvOnDAQRp8GulnZXpZLQbENVf4_VZQSje0BRvEF2d5lefuIvELq8-lI3_n9NX8hOw7rN3oay2eJc6AjOyqF0pz3V8qYKKDlN1vK71goZYOzEuoBUoDsZovszrmp7aiFHWRNo-xa0Q5938t6G6UgicY0w70VplO9aLHTWj9IS9SDxZrHSyaF7KQUUnY3MzTW9Njem-XRaDNUjSDLJaZb2ajQB_PizvimdDPR127cStlzdX9WaqrUdBzHzedwsUpNFOCVKzXtL-3YQMaFygkYLJCntFIwTBdfKVBCV6nJonOYYY-ODYEl4ziQBfXwYAkdlAg7phIowcFlg2sVA7D3vCYsHAMcMf0BszEtkPG89Jjg-ZQ_z18_vus02v1g5zi3XdWI1SO7f0_K__V_j-pvAAAA__-u2J4z) for rejecting the offer during the meeting, but the department said Wednesday that it is "_focused on serving our city by answering 911 calls and aggressively fighting violent crime_ ," adding, "_Federal authorities have a different mission with the same importance_." A [new state law](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0DGu4yAQxvHT4I4IeBjbBcU27t62W1rEDGYUbLIwMXm3XzlX2GaakX766_vzvXw7THhsv90Olt4hLwe0moAIylKfr1JdgcN5PNFDPTNBqatblFA9l4LLYfEO08-iO2_vwk-yAysHI8w0jqPsolUD-BXUtA7q7k0_mV7qMMqghfe9MbJDe2FSyEFKIeVwWyft19GZLx16fV8npgV4pFxuFIHg7WpIP_mEclvz3iUbiZ6Vff1iamZqbq3dHo3e15Op-bKZmoW5jmJqvmNKvMDfFxY8Nk7REf-gvEYoGELlLZcHb0iRB_BQXOK477gVR5gP7l4Uc0FCqDyC85VvV8yRS-Ue6oOpuSvWPxumhNUMTIttd5g-tfR_G59W_QsAAP__lOyTgg) requires every sheriff's office with a jail to participate in the 287(g) program by Dec. 1 of next year. Currently, at least 143 law enforcement agencies in Texas are participating in the program.
## Voters Divided on New Spurs Arena
Bexar County voters are [divided](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkbGO5CAQRL_GznoEGNsQOLjE2V56odVAs4OWAQvwsPv3p5lf2PCpu0qqqn8fxweGGNLnX3zQ1r59PhL1Gqk1Kkc9r1KxUEIXnsFRfeZGpVo8BBMzcAZ8PRyG-HPI0W2GOc1H2vi6sEUrpfh43xhTizdMWjlPypKX06wXZWellZaO4Ri2lxlnfOWccb7erJbOKlwm6WdprB4kIxdaLrd2p0bfWH38yU8qN5sfY9zurZ11mP4MYh_E3nu_fVGq8-s6iB1LCzbSIPZ65tLqIPZk8I1XeVHERrXB1SrCmWOEeH1Rx_KAep0vCSTq8P4Gl3tquSd4lwLJIFRMgKnlFPIgdrFOwNYJUXsPdp4NyMkgIGkBBr1nDp00zI9lc2cPMYa6rINknw8M8Z2n_W6F5yb-BwAA__9_TJ27) on the issue of allocating up to $311 million from local hotel and car rental taxes for the construction of a new San Antonio Spurs arena. The proposed arena is the [centerpiece](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkDGypCAQQE-DWU8BomJAsInZ33RDq5X2Sy0DFrAyc_st5go_7q73-vWfr_ULnXfh-zc-yZTXEddANXsqhdKar38pY6KA1t3OUr5joZR3XCWXAwgOYlotOv9eVWfNxu0sOjJiGvk4a61FdxpFqAYUWz_vXAkcSI5Ka61kb7deSeycaTDBxSQEF2J67LOyu8axV8egtn1mipN1JaZHOanQC_Ph3_Gm9Njjs_PmLOXKrP_F5MLkUmt9_M1Y2pDJpdUwufi4o2dyaSomF8GZXLhu62eE6ryHC99wxAQIgSp8yuGTDi6AjTWUWANkDIChxOAiNAvQ6_LoQnN0ydirsVweJ6b49xOd_9xYfvbZ28j_AQAA__91042d) of a hotly debated downtown redevelopment plan dubbed Project Marvel. The city has agreed to allocate up to $489 million toward the arena, while the Spurs have pledged $500 million and the cost of any overruns. According to a [UT San Antonio poll](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLuu3CAUAL8Gd1jA4ldBkcbdTZvSOobjXSIMCI69d_8-sov8wO1Ho9H8-Vq-wAcfn79hR0PfW1oivmtAIixLzUepUDCC86d3WM9EWKqFRQnVcSm4HBYHPnwW3TizCjfJBo0cetFP4zjK5mWm0a7r9sBt2FTnlIZBWr06Da7TUvZ9480lk0IOUgoph9ZO2tkR-ofeOr3aiWmBzlMqLb2Q8BvqFj7pxNLatDfBvIhyZY9fTM1MzVd-e1CFFt3B1HzJmZqlYGo-iFeIHCKl6BPPKQRe8EQIlRNm73g9ck6F-JYKj_jm9wF-L-CVSopPLP-hqwFCuOFc0l-0xHcoJwam5qYYl98-BF_7gWnx3MGHu5h-9vk06l8AAAD__yFlljw) of 660 likely voters conducted earlier this month, 40% support Proposition B, while 46% oppose it, and 14% are undecided. When asked about Project Marvel, 45% of voters said they want it to move forward, while 40% oppose it. The Spurs claim a new arena would spur $1.4 billion in local development and are urging voters to [back the proposal](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOszAQhJ_GdCCvA8YULv6GLn97JVrsJbHk2JG9geTtT5x0T3DtaDSj7_u6LlcMMaTbf3yQ5feWl0RHjcRMZanPV6lYKKEPe_BU98xUqsNFSTW0IFsYF48hfpa-8XaVfoKGLIxa6skYA83dGjfAqletNgl6cNpIs0qlvTdKaw9DE-w5BhJGAAkwdm7qvTOoL_029KubRC_JB86l4zsxvbFu8ZN3Kp3LjybaO_Oziss_oWah5uM4uoruVQolPhtCzSeSUHPF1GLinEJuf6OTsMV1zcxCzU2x_nmEGEPVo-jl7YEh_tzw3-TsVn0HAAD__4Gpeeo) and "keep tourist dollars here at home, not in the hands of Greg Abbott and Dan Patrick." During a [protest](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGurCAURb9GOwwgAhYUr7Gb177SnIHjyAsOBs7ozN_feO8n3G4nO9k7a_27zTeIKT4ff2FDR-8lz088a0IiLHPdX6VCwSeEeMSA9ciEpXqYJZcDE5wJMweI6TOrNrg7D6No0QmjuR6ttaJdnVrMYMH0PQwa-oAavQ2waAh-sdKPbXTXmODCCMGFMJ0fVfAWdK-WQd392CiOIVIuHa1I-Ia6pE8-sHQ-b21yK9Fem_5PI6dGTud5dh9Yc77aRk4XTiMnKBR9wiv6vFe2IZXMXuWBlf1QsYL_0ROTgguu-Mi7lbbUFhf2M6YUqzaN4o8NYvo-pt_pOpz8CgAA__9D2IC9) against the arena funding earlier this month, a local organizer said, "_Our scarce public funds are not play toys_."
## DPS Deploys Drone Detection Technology
The Texas Department of Public Safety (DPS) is the first law enforcement agency in the nation to deploy a technology that enables aircraft to [detect airborne drones](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkD2u4yAURldjd1hcQsAUFNO4e9NOaWG4jpEIWHBjJ7sfOVt4_fejc_79zD8uppgff90TLb3XMmc8W0IirHPbX7W5itmFeMSA7SiEtXk3Cy7uDDgDPQcX02eWfbALDwZ6tKAVV2YcR-g3q-630Zsw6mCMRANyAdDcy8WsUkk0fbTXGHDQABxAD97I4EenbnK9y8WbTnIMkUodaEPCt2tr-pQD6-DLs092I9pbd_vTiakT03mew1reQm3l1ajkK9SJ6aLqxPSts7A3tmGKvuwXD_Mus1xOFpDQEwu1ZGys7Fgdldr6asN-xpRiU7qT_PF0MX3P6XfKDiv-BwAA___1U4M6) and their operators. The Airborne Counter Unmanned Aircraft Systems (ACUS) was installed on a DPS helicopter in August, and crews received specialized training on its use. The technology [cannot disable a drone](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkD3u4yAUxE-DOywe4K-CYht32XZLi_CeY7QELCB2cvuVI-0J_tUUo99oZv7clpv1wcfHb_skU99rWiKdJVCtlJeyv3KxmaJFf3ikcqRKuTi7SCE7DoLDsKD14bPoBs1d4AQNGRh60U_jOEKzGSKEFWjoelSyW5Ukde8daS2FUpPQjTdXGAgYAATA0LpJoxttr_Ta6bubmBaEvqbc1o0qvW1ZwycdlFuXnk0wW617YeoXkzOT83me7d-3jZfJ5HytYXL-Yv-V4164jTG9oqPCI528kttiCunx4a9CyGvixdnI15Q55hTpgptscD99CL70A9Pi8bQ-fEvUn113GPkvAAD___h3hWo), but it helps pilots avoid in-flight collisions. "_As drone use continues to evolve and expand across the country, so does the potential for these devices to be misused in ways that threaten public safety and law enforcement operations_ ," [said an agency representative](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkDHOozAQRk8DnSPbP8FQuNiGLttuiQZ7CCMZG3lmIbn9KrnC9t97-vT-POYHUKL8_A07enmtZc54cUIRrDMffytDxQyRTorIZxGsHGC22t6V0cq4OQKl99y10S86jqZFb1yv-3EYBtNuHsFGB9YBOOe0dWvfo0Y3jnq5O4O6Jf-RGW2cMdoYdwtjF8MA_U-33rsljE2nMZKUepMNBV_Aa3qXE-stlL1NfhM5uPn51dipsVOElIDxdVRk_iwaO7GAYGOnL6yOkiigSghRZRAqWV0km1qpsiigupSaUSW4FOa11IA7ZlGxlowqomD4MvxmwY-9rT4eF6VE3Lum088dKH2_yf8VPb39FwAA__8vaI8s). In July, a helicopter being used for search and rescue operations in Kerr County was [struck by a drone](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkD2u2zAQhE8jdWuQlKyfQkUady9tSmFNrqxFVqRArmQ7pw8c5AavHQwG832_vuYvZOH4-IkbTfpa0hzpWYRUKc9lP3LBTBEDnxyonEkpF4-zM-4K1oDt54As77mtw3Q3YbQ1TbbvTDcOw2DrdXIe0d3dYK0hHBp0S09jZ5emoWvTtL7m6TNmje2tNdb2Fz-2wQ_YNe1ybe9-rFpDgTXli66k9MKyyDudlC8-bbVMq-pequZH5W6Vu33utwUjRk2R06fzP63cTZJHqdztN-V8sgiBF8y8MBUIOUUCjmeSkwJwhJWEfdqVMnD0HCgqPLEAHrqmzH8owCIpBY4PWI-o4HHbYXsXZQ-FMPsVMAbIVPxBdZ7C_mQRLl1fteaxIcs_BP2e-HNyfwMAAP__nR6eXw), forcing it to make an emergency landing.
| Flying together with our sponsor [](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykz72OAiEUxfGngc4Jl0E-Copt7Nx2S3IH7igJygRw1LffuK-wxelOfsn_5xzOmEu-X77xRn681hru9OyFxqAW-vZoHRvdMeU9J-p7HdR6xCCFPB5AHMCEhLm8g-LJLyI54OTBaKGdtRb41SMIo2c7r8ckjLAuGrvgohAsmZmi5dl_MBBgAASAmaJTKVrUs1qPaomOKUEpj9qmcaVBL-xreded2hTrjRd_HWPrbP5i8sTkaWt1ujTCER-N-ufC5OkzqawG53jzaXvmUnLXhilxuWEuf9L4X__u5W8AAAD___ofblI) **Neil Armstrong’s SHOCKING Apollo 11 Confession:** [You won’t see THIS in any history book](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykz72OAiEUxfGngc4Jl0E-Copt7Nx2S3IH7igJygRw1LffuK-wxelOfsn_5xzOmEu-X77xRn681hru9OyFxqAW-vZoHRvdMeU9J-p7HdR6xCCFPB5AHMCEhLm8g-LJLyI54OTBaKGdtRb41SMIo2c7r8ckjLAuGrvgohAsmZmi5dl_MBBgAASAmaJTKVrUs1qPaomOKUEpj9qmcaVBL-xreded2hTrjRd_HWPrbP5i8sTkaWt1ujTCER-N-ufC5OkzqawG53jzaXvmUnLXhilxuWEuf9L4X__u5W8AAAD___ofblI)... But after becoming the first man to set foot on the moon... Neil Armstrong reported a strange encounter he had in space during a post-mission debrief. And he wasn’t the only astronaut to experience it. NASA did its best to keep it secret... However, newly unearthed NASA audio is blowing the lid off everything. I've watched him stand toe-to-toe with the Deep State, defend President Trump when it wasn't popular, and never back down from the Left's attacks on our values. Barry doesn't just talk about being America First - he lives it. As a veteran who served our country in uniform and a small business owner who helped create jobs, he understands what's at stake. That's the Barry Moore I know and that's the Senator Alabama and America deserves. The Swamp is already targeting this race. They know Barry can't be bought, can't be intimidated, and won't compromise our conservative principles for a photo op or a pat on the head from the media. They're scared of Barry Moore - and they should be! I've been in plenty of fights with the DC establishment, and I can tell you: we need more warriors like Barry in the Senate. He's proven he'll stand with us when the pressure is on and the cameras are off. The Swamp is already working to win red seats across the country. They're betting they can buy this Senate seat with special interest money and slick campaign ads. They're wrong, but only if patriots like you step up. Barry's not running for the Senate because he needs a job. He's running because our country needs leaders who will fight for faith, family, and freedom - not the radical agenda being pushed by Chuck Schumer and his woke allies. The Senate Conservatives Fund will pay all processing fees and transfer 100% of your contribution to Barry's campaign. It's the best way to help push him on to victory! I've fought alongside Congressman Barry Moore, and I'll be proud to fight alongside Senator Barry Moore. But first, we need to win this race. name: Patrick J. Murphy
subject: From the Front with Patrick J. Murphy
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP25/1/106220/images/PJM_Logo.png]
Hi Friends,
Some weeks remind you exactly why you do the work you do. This was one of them.
On Monday, I hosted a Warrior Money Q&A where we talked about how veterans can navigate their finances without paychecks during the government shutdown, while taking control of their financial futures.
It was a powerful discussion on preparing for life’s knocks, building confidence, and making informed financial choices that strengthen our military families.
Watch the full episode → Warrior Money Q&A [https://youtu.be/gL399R82T1g]
A Historic Peace Deal
In my latest Substack, I reflected on President Trump’s historic deal in the Middle East that freed the last 20 living hostages from Gaza — a moment two years in the making.
This is a moment that should be celebrated by all who treasure humanity, hope, freedom, and a path to a better future - while acknowledging this is the third hostage deal—and the one that makes the strongest case to end the war.
The first & second were under President Biden’s leadership - the Nov 2023 release of 50 hostages and the second was Jan 2025 before inauguration releasing 33. . Read the full essay on Substack → President Trump’s Historic Deal in the Middle East [https://open.substack.com/pub/patrickmurphypa/p/president-trumps-historic-deal-in?utm_campaign=post&utm_medium=web]
Service in Action
On Monday and Tuesday, I attended the AUSA Annual Conference, joining 30K defense leaders and innovators from across the country. The conversations centered on one clear theme: investing in people. Our Army’s greatest strength will always be those who wear the cloth of our countryand the families who stand beside them.
See the full schedule → AUSA Annual Meeting Agenda [https://meetings.ausa.org/annual/2025/documents/AM_2025_Tentative_Agenda_Updated_9_18.pdf]
In the Media
October 16th at 3 PM, I joined Martha MacCallum on Fox News to discuss the issues facing veterans and military families today. We focused on leadership that delivers results and what it means to serve beyond politics.
Watch → The Story with Martha MacCallum [https://www.foxnews.com/shows/the-story]
https://drive.google.com/file/d/1rSVx38CLk0kuF991vmln6O2SFhenx7zS/view?usp=drive_link [https://drive.google.com/file/d/1rSVx38CLk0kuF991vmln6O2SFhenx7zS/view?usp=drive_link]
Also tomorrow, my Federal News Network radio show will feature stories from veterans who continue to lead in business, government, and community life.
Watch here → Federal News Network [https://federalnewsnetwork.com/shows/federal-drive-with-terry-gerton-podcast/]
And later this week, a new Hilco Global Podcast continuing our ongoing conversation about the challenges business leaders face during these incredibly volatile times.
The Throughline: Service Never Stops
Even as our work takes us in different directions, our shared mission remains the same. Service does not end when the uniform comes off. It continues through leadership, compassion, and the commitment to lift others every day.
Thank you for being part of our team.
Honorable Patrick J. Murphy
32nd Army Under Secretary

Matt Cole is helping lead a financial revolution that puts values--and value creation--back at the center of American capitalism. As CEO of **Strive Asset Management** , Matt is one of the nation's most articulate voices pushing back against ESG mandates that put politics over performance.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/24a1e309-5dac-4bc5-86f1-979e09254024?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
A seasoned investor and futurist, Matt warns that the same centralization we see in ESG is now emerging in the digital economy--from centralized banking systems to the next wave of AI and Bitcoin-based innovation.
His message is simple but urgent: Americans must reclaim agency--over their work, their wealth, and their future.
At **[Seed& Roots 2025](https://substack.com/redirect/24a1e309-5dac-4bc5-86f1-979e09254024?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**, Matt will unpack how Bitcoin and blockchain technologies are reshaping the financial landscape, why the "anti-ESG" movement isn't about politics but freedom, and how small businesses and everyday workers can benefit from the coming shift in capital markets.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/24a1e309-5dac-4bc5-86f1-979e09254024?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

Peter,

[**Anti-abortion extremists are escalating their attacks on medication abortion with increasingly desperate schemes.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/117448166/576513969/1824768205?sourceid=1150915&utm_campaign=26emama-1009aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=medication&amtOpts=&recurringAmtOpts=&am=&recurringAm=&is_optimized_ask=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhNjA1NjM0OC01YmFiLWYwMTEtOGU2MS02MDQ1YmRlZDhiYTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Rj9mHAdx44lzFaUc4tKGLOMibSfe8wEX_y--mF_WT2I=&emci=11ea972f-f1a9-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&emdi=a6056348-5bab-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&ceid=954237)

We're seeing a trend where men are filing lawsuits against their partners—or ex-partners—in a disturbing attempt to block abortion access, especially abortion by mail. And now, Texas has passed a law encouraging private citizens to sue health providers for mailing abortion pills—or even _intending_ to do so.

[**This is nothing more than an abusive control tactic designed to intimidate people by surveilling their most private health decisions.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/117448169/576514026/1824768205?sourceid=1150915&utm_campaign=26emama-1009aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=medication&amtOpts=&recurringAmtOpts=&am=&recurringAm=&is_optimized_ask=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhNjA1NjM0OC01YmFiLWYwMTEtOGU2MS02MDQ1YmRlZDhiYTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Rj9mHAdx44lzFaUc4tKGLOMibSfe8wEX_y--mF_WT2I=&emci=11ea972f-f1a9-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&emdi=a6056348-5bab-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&ceid=954237)

As my colleague Molly Duane stated last week in an article in _The Nation:_
> _"Texas extremists are mad they can't control what is happening outside their borders so they're trying to extend their extraterritorial tentacles into other states—even though that's antithetical to our system of federalism."_
The anti-abortion movement is proving that they'll stop short of nothing to completely erode access to abortion care, which is why they're pursuing this egregious and abusive tactic.

We can't afford to stop fighting. [**We must call out these cruel schemes for what they are and work together to defend reproductive freedom.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/117448173/576514031/1824768205?sourceid=1150915&utm_campaign=26emama-1009aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=medication&amtOpts=&recurringAmtOpts=&am=&recurringAm=&is_optimized_ask=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhNjA1NjM0OC01YmFiLWYwMTEtOGU2MS02MDQ1YmRlZDhiYTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Rj9mHAdx44lzFaUc4tKGLOMibSfe8wEX_y--mF_WT2I=&emci=11ea972f-f1a9-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&emdi=a6056348-5bab-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&ceid=954237)

Sincerely,

Marc Hearron

Friends, I get a lot of outreach from folks asking: What can we do?
And I’m so glad you’re asking, because this team’s willingness to step up and fight for our shared values has led to some of our biggest victories over the past several years!
Right now, my #1 answer to that question is to support Democrats who are on the ballot this November.
Every seat in the Virginia House of Delegates is up for grabs in less than three weeks, and our Democratic majority is paper-thin . We must defend it — and we must expand it.
The stakes are high: If Republicans take back control of the House of Delegates, we can bet they’ll try to bring the same MAGA extremism we’ve seen in Washington here to Virginia.
Under a GOP majority in VA, we can expect attacks on our core values like voting rights, an economy that works for all, reproductive freedom, and marriage equality — and we can’t let that happen.
That’s why I’m doing everything I can to help elect these great Democrats who are running in key districts across Virginia. Every one of them is ready to fight for Virginians’ rights and values — and every one of them needs more help to get across the finish line:
* Delegate Josh Thomas (HD-21) [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-cgp-2025-thomas]

* Elizabeth Guzman (HD-22) [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-cgp-2025-guzman]
* John McAuliff (HD-30) [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-cgp-2025-mcauliff]
* Lily Franklin (HD-41) [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-cgp-2025-franklin]
* May Nivar (HD-57) [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-cgp-2025-nivar]

* Stacey Carroll (HD-64) [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-cgp-2025-carroll]

* Jessica Anderson (HD-71) [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-cgp-2025-anderson]
* Leslie Mehta (HD-73) [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-cgp-2025-mehta]

* Lindsey Dougherty (HD-75) [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-cgp-2025-dougherty]
* Kimberly Pope Adams (HD-82) [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-cgp-2025-adams]
* Delegate Nadarius Clark (HD-84) [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-cgp-2025-clark]
In these final weeks, GOP billionaires from around the country are pouring money into Virginia to fund Republican candidates, and national organizations like the RGA and RNC are on the ground trying to defeat our candidates, too.
These great Dems need grassroots support to win, so I’m coming to you for help.
Please join me in supporting these strong Democrats on the ballot in November. You can split a donation between all 12 of them by clicking here. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-cgp-2025-hod]
Or, if you’d like, you can click on any of their names above to support them directly.
Let’s make sure Virginia continues to lead the way forward — and send a powerful message that Trump’s extremism has no place here.
Thanks for always stepping up when it matters most.
Tim Kaine

* Defund radical public universities that indoctrinate, not educate
* Reform education so students learn how to think—not what to think
* Work hand-in-hand with President Trump to put South Carolina FIRST

Through every hardship, Nancy never gave up. And now she’s ready to do what she’s always done: roll up her sleeves, take the heat, and lead from the front. **South Carolina is worth fighting for. And Nancy Mace is just getting started.**

** NEW PATRIOT PACK
------------------------------------------------------------
INCLUDES: TRAVEL CASE, CUTTER & CIGARS!

The Patriot Pack — Smoke for the Bold and the Free

Stand tall and light up freedom with The Patriot Pack from Patriot Cigar Company — a powerful lineup built for true American patriots. Featuring The “Pledge” Premium Leather 3-Cigar Travel Case, the Old Glory Cigar Cutter, and three powerhouse blends — TNT, MOAB, and Sidewinder — this set is your all-American arsenal of premium, hand-rolled cigars. Crafted for quality. Fueled by liberty. Made for those who never back down.
https://mypatriotcigars.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3ea77f33fc36dd7515163e71c&id=10d7051a15&e=fbf55fa623

**
------------------------------------------------------------

** The Patriot Pack
A Bold Salute to Liberty
------------------------------------------------------------

Raise your colors high — the Patriot Pack from Patriot Cigar Company is the ultimate tribute to freedom, made for those who stand proud. This isn’t just a cigar set; it’s a declaration, a statement, and a smoke-filled salute to the red, white, and blue.

** Included Inside the Patriot Pack
------------------------------------------------------------

**
“The Pledge” Premium Leather 3-Cigar Travel Case
------------------------------------------------------------

Carry your cigars in patriotic style. This rugged yet elegant case is crafted in premium printed leather with the pledge of allegiance, built to safeguard your Patriot Cigars while projecting staunch American pride. Designed for travel, with room for three cigars up to a 60-ring size and a secure closure, it’s more than storage—it’s armor for your freedom smoke.

** Old Glory Cigar Cutter
------------------------------------------------------------

No patriot’s toolkit is complete without a sharp edge. The Old Glory Cigar Cutter is a dual-blade instrument worthy of the name. It slices clean and precise, honoring the flag with every snip (and making sure your draw is perfect).
------------------------------------------------------------

** The Finest Blends Under the Flag
------------------------------------------------------------

** TNT
------------------------------------------------------------

Explosive in flavor and bold in character, TNT is a powerhouse medium to full blend that commands your attention. From first light to the last ember, it burns with authority.

** MOAB (Mother of All Bombs)
------------------------------------------------------------

MOAB delivers a full-bodied punch, a maduro cigar that lives up to its name. Deep, rich, and intense — this is not for the faint of heart but for the true patriot who demands maximum firepower in flavor.

** Sidewinder
------------------------------------------------------------

Sleek, swift, and sly — the Sidewinder rounds out the pack with a medium blend that strikes with finesse. Balanced, bold, and full of character, it’s the curveball every patriotic smoker needs.

The Patriot Pack doesn’t stop there, you’ll also get a Patriot-branded beverage koozie, coaster, sticker, and patch—because every smoke session deserves a touch of American pride.
------------------------------------------------------------

** Why the Patriot Pack Matters
------------------------------------------------------------

This is not merely a sampler or gift set. The Patriot Pack is your on-demand arsenal of American spirit and premium craftsmanship. It’s a perfect companion for travel, a striking gift for fellow flag-bearers, or your own daily reminder that freedom is worth celebrating — one premium puff at a time.

Light up The Patriot Pack. Puff with pride. And let the smoke carry your pledge to liberty.

** Uncompromising Quality, Made for Patriots
------------------------------------------------------------

At Patriot Cigar Company, every cigar is handcrafted in Estelí, Nicaragua, using premium-aged tobacco (aged a minimum of three years). Our blends were born from the desire to bring together the love of premium smokes and the love of our country, forging a brand built on passion and pride.

** NEW PREMIUM
8 CIGAR SAMPLER PACK
------------------------------------------------------------
USE PROMO CODE: EAGLE FOR 20% OFF CIGARS
Experience true American freedom with 8 bold, premium cigars—including the gold-wrapped MOGUL and exclusive Operation Never Tell—only available in the Patriot Cigar Company Premium Sampler Pack.

1xMOAB
1xTNT
1xMARK48
1xHellfire
1xSidewinder
1xSidewinder Maduro
1x24K Gold Wrapped Mogul
1xLimited Release Unbanded Operation Never Tell

For the true American cigar patriot, this is the ultimate way to experience the full power, pride, and craftsmanship behind Patriot Cigar Company. The Premium Sampler Pack delivers 8 premium cigars that represent the heart and soul of our lineup—crafted for those who believe in freedom, hard work, and savoring every damn moment.

You’ll receive all 6 flagship blends that built our reputation for bold flavor and uncompromising quality, plus two standouts that make this sampler truly elite: the 24Kt Gold-Wrapped MOGUL, a cigar that radiates luxury and dominance with every draw, and the Limited Release Operation Never Tell—a 5.5×50 Maduro Robusto shrouded in mystery. clean_body: One choice. A generation of impact. | = Peter, the future of our democracy and our fundamental freedoms increasingly hangs in the balance of state Supreme Courts. That's why EMILYs List has invested heavily in state Supreme Court races across the country — including in Wisconsin, where we stood up to Elon Musk's billions and helped elect both Justice Janet Protasiewicz and Justice Susan Crawford to build the court's liberal majority. Now, this November, three justices are up for retention to the Pennsylvania Supreme Court, and we've endorsed Justice Christine Donohue to continue defending our fundamental rights. = | = If all three justices who are up for retention lose, their vacant seats would leave the court with a 2-2 partisan split. That means the court, which has made major decisions around Pennsylvania's voting and elections in recent years, would be deadlocked and unable to settle some of the most critical battles for our democracy. The stakes are high — and Republicans know it too. Pennsylvania's richest man has already poured $1.25 million into this race, which helped fund deeply misleading campaign mailers attacking the justices up for retention. We need Justice Donohue fighting for justice on Pennsylvania's highest court, but this one is going to be a battle over the next three weeks, and we need to know you're with us. **=** If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue, your donation will go through immediately: = | = ---|--- = | = = | = Thank you, Emily Parés (she/her/hers) Deputy Chief Campaigns Officer, State & Local Campaigns, EMILYs List = | | | | ---|---|---|---|--- Thank you for being a supporter of EMILYs List. | | Hi Peter,**Next Friday, October 24th is the last day to register to vote in Virginia. ** It’s easy to feel like the noise of national politics drowns everything out—but **real change begins much closer to home.** It starts in our neighborhoods, our schools, and our communities, when people like you decide to take part. Every movement for progress has begun the same way: with ordinary people refusing to sit on the sidelines. **When we show up—when we engage—we remind those in power that this democracy still belongs to all of us.** So today, please take a moment to do something that strengthens our community. Talk to a neighbor. Share what matters most to you. Encourage someone else to make sure they’re registered. To get involved. _Small actions build powerful momentum._**Because when we all take part, our democracy works exactly as it should—by and for the people.** [We’ve put together information here on voting](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/117455688/576539416/-1405097920?refcode=20251017_lastday_b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjEvMS8xMTAzMTIiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiN2JkNmE1MTUtNjJhYi1mMDExLThlNjEtNjA0NWJkZWQ4YmE0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=YY6tiwrlMZAvplLCAbUDA24rPMjhsICFELRY4POvAZk=&emci=1b30c3da-1ea9-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&emdi=7bd6a515-62ab-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&ceid=10020268), including how to find out if you’re registered, and how to register if you’re not. Please share this information with your neighbors. So many people skip the “local” elections, but the impact of this election will have a lasting impact on every one of us. Encourage them to register and to vote. Thank you for your service,Leslie

Friend,
I'm writing to you tonight with some news that the political insiders and pundits in **Richmond never saw coming**.
We just filed our latest campaign finance report, and the results are in. Our people-powered campaign **outraised my opponent** , bringing in nearly **$17,000** to his **$10,200**. Our grassroots network had **131 donors to his 24**.
The political class has **underestimated this campaign from the start**. They thought a wealthy, self-funding landlord could simply buy this open seat, one that's been out of reach for 25 years. They were wrong.
Our message of keeping our rural hospitals open, ensuring every family has quality health insurance, and paying our teachers a livable wage is resonating.**People are tired of being forgotten** , and they're ready for a change.
**Friend, even if you don't live in Southside, this race is your fight, too.**
Every seat we flip in the House of Delegates is a critical firewall against the dangerous agenda being pushed from Washington. It's **another vote to protect Medicaid from devastating cuts, another vote to fully fund our public schools** , and another vote for a Virginia that truly works for everyone.
**This fundraising report proves we can win.** My opponent will now turn to his deep-pocketed **special interest allies like Dominion** to try to drown out our message. We cannot let that happen. We have to capitalize on this momentum right now.
**I’ve poured my heart into this campaign. On election night, we are going to surprise a lot of people with a message of hope and transformation.

name: Jim Jordan
subject: Democrats doing “Better than ever”
body:
Believe me, I wish this was Fake News...
| | **_A SECURE MEMO TRANSMITTED FROM THE DESK OF REP. JIM JORDAN_**
---
Friend,
---
The Democrats haven’t had much to celebrate recently.
---
**But _CNN_ is taking a victory lap after Democrats added _TWO_ more House seats to their column by winning special elections in Virginia and Arizona!**
_**CNN:
Democrats are doing better than ever in Trump-era special elections**_
“Democrats are over-performing in special elections more than they ever have in the Trump era — dating back to his first term.”
Believe me, I wish this was nothing more than Fake News...
But so far this year, the Democrats have overperformed in all of the House special elections by **_DOUBLE_ _DIGIT_** margins!
The last time Democrats overperformed in special elections with margins anywhere close to these was during President Trump’s first two years in office.
**They went on to FLIP over _40_ House seats in the midterms!**
_And right now, the Democrats are actually doing _BETTER_ than they were back then! _
But there’s one important caveat to all of this: The Democrats aren’t winning special elections by these huge margins because they’re winning more votes.
_Instead, they’re winning because thousands of Republican voters simply aren’t showing up to cast their ballots like they did last November._
**I’ll be perfectly frank with you, Friend: The biggest threat to President Trump’s House majority isn’t from anything the Democrats can do.__It’s from our own voters getting complacent and not turning out to vote.__**
And since we’re ONLY 1 SEAT over the _bare_ _minimum_ _threshold_ to declare a Majority in the House, we truly have no room for error. Losing even a single seat could prove disastrous!
_Given this troubling trend in special elections, I’ve been tasked with determining _exactly_ who President Trump and I can count on to show up and vote in the midterms. _

# [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=1896%2E791427%2E7HM-yS)
Friend — The challenging thing about running for Congress is that your situation can change in an instant.
The day that AIPAC or any other billionaire-backed group gets behind a candidate is the day that this becomes an entirely different race.
AIPAC alone spent over $100,000,000 in elections across the country during the 2024 election cycle. If that sounds like a staggering amount of money, it’s because it is: It’s the most political spending in a single election cycle by any organization in history.
In many cases that money was spent attempting to unseat progressives like me — and in some races, they were successful.
We already learned a few months ago that AIPAC was running polls in my district, testing the waters of supporting a pro-Israel, centrist candidate to run against me.
**We have to start preparing for the fight ahead, right here right now.**
We can’t be caught off-guard. We can’t be put in a position where we have to play catch-up when we should be ahead.
**[So, I’m respectfully asking you to chip into my campaign for reelection today.**](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-oct25.q9Ch2B&refcode=em251017-1-180&t=2&akid=1896%2E791427%2E7HM-yS)

# Woman charged with threatening to kill federal agents, celebrated Charlie Kirk's murder
Bethany Abigail Terrill, 37, of Malden, Massachusetts, **[was arrested and charged](https://substack.com/redirect/fea747d8-1fda-4e0b-a2f0-20a45c04df92?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** with threatening to kill federal agents who were conducting lawful immigration enforcement operations near Malden District Court.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/fea747d8-1fda-4e0b-a2f0-20a45c04df92?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Bethany Abigail Terrill
* **Physical interference with arrest:** Terrill allegedly physically interjected herself between agents during an immigration arrest, screaming "ICE is here," calling agents "monsters," attempting to film them on her mobile phone, and repeatedly pushing through agents despite multiple commands to back up.
* **Death threats captured on camera:** Terrill allegedly yelled, "Charlie Kirk died, and we love it... We're coming for you, gonna kill you" at the identifiable federal agents, with the incident captured on agents' body cameras and allegedly on her mobile phone.
* **Faces up to 10 years in prison:** The charge of threatening a United States official carries a maximum sentence of 10 years in prison, three years of supervised release, and a $250,000 fine, though Terrill is presumed innocent unless proven guilty beyond a reasonable doubt.

# U.S. drone strike of drug smuggling vessel leaves few survivors

Sununu represented New Hampshire in Congress nearly twenty years ago. And throughout his time in DC, he put special interests ahead of Granite Staters every chance he got. His record speaks for itself — he voted against lowering drug prices, repeatedly voted to restrict abortion access, and led efforts to privatize Social Security. And what has he done since leaving office? Joined a lobbying firm that represented corporate special interests. Now he’s national Republicans’ handpicked candidate for this race. We can't stress this enough: For less than the price of a latte at your local coffee shop, you can help cover the costs of registering a new voter.
We have to start now to be ready for next year's elections. RUSH $12 or more today and help us register a tidal wave of new voters nationwide >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?refcode=101725_1&amount=12]
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
Our voter registration work doesn't end, folks.
Despite vote-suppressing state legislatures making it harder to register to vote -- passing bills to stop organizations like ours and our partners on the ground from helping potential voters navigate the increasingly murky rules around voter registration -- we're still pulling out all the stops to bring voters into the system.
Voter registration is a critical part of grassroots efforts to protect voting rights. The more people who vote, the more our government looks like we, the people. But to get to the point where every voice is heard, we need your help .
Just $3 can help us register a new voter. Will you chip in $12 or more today to help register 4 new voters? >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?refcode=101725_1&amount=12]
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:
GIVE $15 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?express_lane=true&refcode=101725_1&amount=15] GIVE $25 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?express_lane=true&refcode=101725_1&amount=25] GIVE $50 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?express_lane=true&refcode=101725_1&amount=50]

Voter participation has been increasing, and young people -- a major target of opponents of voting rights -- see the importance of voting now more than ever. Voting quickly becomes a habit -- a habit our democracy sorely needs to fulfill the promise of the American dream. Overwhelming key states with new voter registrations can help turn the tide against the voter suppression laws we've seen passed the last few years.
The next election will determine whether our democracy stays mired in the darkness and conspiracy theories we hear every day or if we can reclaim our rights -- from voting to choice and more -- and march forward to a better future.
New voter registration -- at just about $3 per new voter -- can make a huge difference. Please, can you pitch in with $12 or whatever you can to help us register a wave of new voters ahead of this year's registration deadlines? >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?refcode=101725_1&amount=12]

Voter Action Project's Registration Team

Since the Supreme Court gutted key provisions in the Voting Rights Act, extreme politicians have taken advantage to pass harsh laws that restrict access to the ballot box. It’s our goal to bring awareness to these laws wherever they may crop up and organize voters to take action to ensure the right to vote is available to everyone in their states and communities.

A federal grand jury just indicted _John Bolton._ Boltin is Donald Trump's former National Security Adviser -- **making him the _third_ of Trump's critics charged in recent weeks. **
---
| [ ](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqvUWHo9tkdcudztgboR-91DBeU2X_hC7i-AB5ypRc2qsPb6w9L_PC_7oQceelzyXmnispedB6uQ1AF56mdTrL3zxVYn1Qblad75bNqoTbLie22MLBYiE_guKf-N-XzuOGhLwcy98aogmLl8zvk3Kjyep5obkFTQaVgR27jjD3woH1jJdvcscygEG7FTJr9ANRdZXRqsb93XsI8xRXh7JFM71ncVXsICC4ZbOWQ_amWlrxG3kwT5lSjhpxLEMS7rxzrtU-1jMZcEKnY88RPNna7_JeTYRrv2NQT3SozGXilQQ2wXDiyq-8XixtgH7Okh0xbbf8o1K7IfBsOnJeECki-FwgGKhTNo4ASEAkKdsPPewUm1LviViNCrFWR9dtn6Htm6tM2ft8vFNk0bGkeBf_vp/4kt/4ouNyevATPGlvXw7JSfe4A/h1/h001.PcSgqqXFBHbR0xyK_3BbIu2Dj2idFSK16y9XfXLKEEo)
---
Think about that: **not a Democrat, not a liberal _ -- but one of Trump's own._** A lifelong Republican who once stood by his side is now the latest victim of Trump's escalating campaign of political retribution. From former FBI Director James Comey to New York Attorney General Letitia James -- **and now Bolton** -- anyone who dares to dissent is being targeted. Trump is using the Justice Department as a weapon to silence opposition and consolidate power. If Trump can turn the full force of government against his _own former allies_ , imagine what happens to the rest of us -- **to activists, journalists, and anyone who refuses to fall in line.** No one is safe in Trump's America. And after reading this email, if you agree that my opponent is the wrong person to be leading New Jersey, I hope you’ll **[split whatever you can between my campaign and Heartland Patriots to help me win this upcoming election.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/96673?refcode=em20251017-9586&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=9586%2E614464%2EvmL-cc)**

Not only did he urge Republican Members of Congress to vote for Trump’s agenda — _he’s promising to implement it at the state level here in New Jersey, too._

Peter, it’s abundantly clear — **Jack Ciattarelli is out of touch with New Jersey, and we cannot let him become the next governor of our state.**

How do you feel about the Mountain Home Mayor being excited for Mountain Home residents to learn about Sharia Law?
Check it out:
[](https://substack.com/redirect/e891e73a-d775-47cb-825f-256e6a225026?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Sharia law is 100% incompatible with the First Amendment, equal protection under law, due process, and human rights.
_There 's no "learning" to be done here except understanding that we're importing an ideology that rejects the very foundation of our republic._
The Mayor celebrating this as some multicultural opportunity shows how consequential the woke mind virus is. We're supposed to smile and nod while importing a legal and religious system that explicitly seeks to replace our Constitution?
For those dismissing this as "fearmongering" or an "overreaction," consider the real-world consequences of our naive approach to vetting and cultural integration.
In December 2019, Mohammed Saeed Alshamrani, a Saudi national _we welcomed, trained, and hosted at Naval Air Station Pensacola,_ murdered three American service members on U.S. soil.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/c71f76db-8bf0-4d5a-b0c9-b868071d88e7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
_**We imported him.**_
_**We trained him.**_
_**And he killed Americans.**_
This is what happens when we prioritize diversity optics over security and refuse to acknowledge ideological incompatibilities.
This is civilizational suicide dressed up as tolerance.
**P.S.** Pat Buchanan warned us about _all of this_ ...
At the 1992 Republican National Convention, he delivered his famous "Culture War" speech, declaring there was _**" a religious war going on in our country for the soul of America."**_ He warned that the battle was about who we are, what we believe, and what we stand for as Americans.
(The media and political establishment mocked him. They said he was "divisive" and "extreme")
Thirty years later, we have mayors celebrating Sharia law education in Idaho.
In his prophetic masterpiece "The Death of the West" Buchanan predicted that mass immigration combined with multiculturalism would erode Western civilization and fundamentally transform American identity. He warned that elites were actively working to deconstruct the cultural foundations of the nation.
In "State of Emergency: The Third World Invasion and Conquest of America" he specifically warned about importing incompatible ideologies through mass immigration. He argued America was committing "cultural suicide" by refusing to assimilate immigrants into American values and instead celebrating every imported culture as equally valid, regardless of compatibility with constitutional governance.
As if these weren't enough, in "Suicide of a Superpower: Will America Survive to 2025?" he detailed how America's elites were celebrating the demographic and cultural transformation of the country while ordinary citizens watched their nation fundamentally change before their eyes. He argued that nations require shared values, language, culture, and history to survive, and when diversity becomes the highest value, the nation dissolves.
For raising these concerns, Buchanan was relentlessly attacked as a xenophobe, racist, and fearmonger. The establishment worked overtime to discredit and silence him.
_Now a mayor in Idaho celebrates Sharia law education as progress._
A Saudi national we trained murdered Americans on our own soil. Everything Buchanan warned about is happening in real time.
He was right about everything (and they destroyed him for telling the truth).

name: Morgan Hine

body:
| | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/1d64c9550504/apply-now-campaign-readiness-bootcamp?e=d6c5c7d7ec)
---
| |
---
| | | **A Message from the DNC National Training Team**
---
|
---
| Dear Friends,

Safeguarding the fundamental right to vote is a key component of our work across the country. With attacks on voting rights sweeping the nation, it’s important now more than ever before to recruit and invest in strong voter protection teams to protect voters in the 2026 election and beyond. The DNC is launching a training program specifically designed to train state party staff, organizers, legal professionals, and law students who are interested in voter protection work, and we need your help with sharing this application far and wide! The DNC is excited to announce the return of the Voter Protection Campaign Readiness Bootcamp! We are seeking individuals interested in pursuing careers in voter protection. This training bootcamp is for Democrats of all backgrounds and skill levels who are interested in a Voter Protection position for the 2026 cycle and beyond. This three-day bootcamp is free to attend, and all skill sets are welcome. The bootcamp will consist of two tracks: Voter Protection 101 and the Organizer to Voter Protection Pipeline. Voter Protection 101 is for individuals with limited knowledge and background in voter protection work, and for those with an interest in voting rights who want to learn how state parties and campaigns protect the voting process. This cohort may include attorneys, law school graduates, law students, and organizers interested in learning more about voter protection. The Organizer to Voter Protection Pipeline is for individuals who have worked on two or more campaigns or in a state party and are interested in learning how to transfer their skills to protect the vote. Based on a participant's resume and the skills assessment, the Training and Civic Engagement and Voter Protection Departments (the “team”) will assign an applicant to the track that will maximize their learning experience during the boot camp. After the team notifies applicants of their acceptance into the program, they will receive information about their track placement.

Team,

It’s been a scary week in Chicago. We’ve seen story after story of federal agents descending on the largest city in our state, people being shot, and immigrants ripped from their communities.

But here’s the thing about Chicago: _**We don’t back down.**_

Trump said that Chicago Mayor Brandon Johnson and Gov. JB Pritzker should “be in jail”. Pritzker told him to “come and get me.”

| | Patriot,

Washington has failed our military.

Due to the government shutdown, **thousands of active-duty service members are working without pay** , while politicians in Congress continue to receive their taxpayer-funded salaries. Shutting down our government at the expense of our servicemembers is not leadership, it's betrayal.

As a**retired Air Force Lieutenant Colonel** , I know the sacrifices our men and women in uniform make. In Congress, I will ensure that when they serve our country, Congress will take care of their families.

Right now, our nation's servicemembers **are struggling to buy groceries, pay bills, and provide for their families** , all because career politicians are playing partisan games instead of doing their jobs.

## Democrats keep moving the goalpost...
We're officially on day 17 of the government shutdown.
And no clear end in sight.
It's got me wondering. . . what is this really about?
Not a rhetorical question.
The Democrats seem hell-bent on this shutdown, but they still won't say exactly what they want.
They've voted 10 times now to keep the government shut down.
They've complained about plenty:
Medicare subsidies, healthcare for illegals, it's the same thing we've heard a million times.
And now this week, the No Kings rally is coming to town, giving them a boost of support.
Maybe they wanted to keep the government shut down during the rally because they didn't want to lose a talking point -- after all, their supporters are come to rally in DC and I'm sure there's no cancellation on the various youth hostels they are staying in.
But what's their endgame?
I, for one, am genuinely curious what this shutdown is really about.
Let's break it down. ...

body:
President Trump’s “Peace Through Strength” doctrine has given us peace in the Middle East!

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/5c55aa911d6c/welcome-to-team-grantham-10141256?e=0b767f7f9d)

| | | | | |
Friend,
For years, Democrats, the media, and even some Republicans believed the conventional wisdom about the Middle East and the inability of the United States to bring stability to the region. The conventional wisdom was that we could not achieve peace without a two-state solution or Israel making concessions to other nations in the region, creating a less safe environment for Israel. _**This past week, President Trump put conventional wisdom to bed and brokered a peace deal worthy of a Nobel Peace Prize!**_
President Trump understood that in this conflict, we should support Israel against its enemies and show **“Peace Through Strength** ” when it was necessary. The Trump Administration openly supported Israel in this conflict, and it was that explicit support that led to majority-Muslim nations flipping sides. By making it clear that Israel was willing to take out terror leaders, in countries where they were, nations like Qatar were put on notice. Those same nations have now signed the peace agreement.
_**The historic Peace Deal**_ that was signed, ending this two-year-long war, is further evidence of the success of President Trump’s foreign policy strategy, and has fundamentally realigned the players in the Middle East. Among President Trump’s lasting legacies will be his commitment to Israel, his leadership against prevailing, incorrect conventional wisdom, and his efforts to make the Middle East safer, which in turn makes Americans safer by extension.
In Arizona, I have consistently advocated for a foreign policy that supports our allies, refuses to apologize for American strength, and makes it clear to our enemies that we will always display Peace Through Strength. **I will do the same in Congress.** The American people deserve a foreign policy that achieves our objectives and keeps Americans and our military safe!

body:
Following Trump sending federal troops to Oregon and cities nationwide, this week, I led an amendment with Senator Wyden to require federal military and law enforcement agents to display their agency and name or badge number at protests.
| | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/117469754/576583240/150430950?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDEvMS84OTMyNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmODc5ODgwNS03M2FiLWYwMTEtOGU2MS02MDQ1YmRlZDhiYTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=xsEKGrPJDiEDFwc0iz0eO5v8y7pjp96EXlGftImDaLM=&emci=ad9ed9d1-5eab-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&emdi=f8798805-73ab-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&ceid=7731215)
---

| | Following Trump sending federal troops to Oregon and cities nationwide, last week, I led an amendment with Senator Wyden to require federal military and law enforcement agents engaged in crowd control or enforcement actions against protestors to display their names or unique identification and agency or service branch. There is a name for unidentified security forces throwing protesters into unmarked vans at the direction of an authoritarian government: fascism. This happened under Trump in 2020 and is happening now across the country. Every single Democrat supported my amendment. But every single Republican opposed it, killing it. That tells you a lot. **Not one Republican will stand up against Trump's authoritarian tactics.** Without personal identifiers, agents feel free to attack peaceful protesters, striving to incite violence. body:

---
Derek, we’re sure you’re following the news. Trump is doing everything he can to dismantle our democracy piece by piece: encouraging his allies to redraw congressional districts in their favor, sending the National Guard into cities like Chicago and Portland, threatening the free press, the list goes on... But here’s the thing: **The power of the people is greater than the people in power.** So at a moment when Trump wants us to be silent, we have to be louder than we’ve ever been before. Thousands of supporters have stepped up in the last few weeks to show they have the Democratic Party’s back and are ready to win races at all levels. With their support, the DNC has invested millions of dollars in voter turnout efforts from Virginia to New Jersey to California in order to win big in November. We aren’t just deciding the future of a couple of states next month.
