My opponent, Jason Miyares, won’t stand up against Trump’s policies or his corporate donors. 🔵 Right here in Virginia, our civil liberties are under threat, from reproductive rights to voting access. Miyares is an anti-abortion extremist who has fought against expanding voting rights.🔵 Trump’s federal overreach is hurting Virginia’s workforce, healthcare, and democracy. Miyares is too weak to stand up to him. Voters should know exactly how Miyares is failing to protect us – and canvassing is how we reach them. But it takes resources to keep this effort going strong. We need flyers to keep voters informed, clipboards to keep canvassers organized, pens to sign up supporters, and water bottles to keep canvassers hydrated. name: Ernest Lineberger
subject: Update from Ernest Lineberger, Oct 17, 2025
body:
Hi Friends of Lineberger for US Congress!

The Constitutional Amendment - Special election starts Monday
with Early Voting! I have a favor to ask of those of you in or near the
district who may have one or more of my campaign signs. If possible and
not too much trouble, dust off that Ernest Lineberger campaign sign and
plant it at one of our polling locations on Monday (in an allowed spot, not
in the right of way, and no closer than 100 feet from the entrance to the
polling location building). This is just another way to try to increase my
name recognition in the district. You can find the polling place(s)
nearest you in Denton County by going to votedenton.gov. There are 41 of
them for early voting this election. It’s also a good time to verify your
voter registration status. If you do place a sign, it needs to be picked
up after voting on the final election day, November 4, 2025. Thanks.

I have also attached a very brief voting guide that you can use
to Premark your sample ballot or just take the voter guide with you to
vote. It has the same information twice. So, after you print it, you can
cut it across the middle and give one to a friend.

Some people say that campaign signs don’t make a difference, but
I’ve had a lot of people say that they have seen my signs. It definitely
helps. And since I can’t afford TV commercials, we need to make the most
of what we do have.

Tomorrow is the No Kings National Protest Day. I hope those of
you that want to join have found a nearby event. Please have good, family
friendly signs, be kind, and show all of our neighbors that we are
protesting peacefully. They have nothing to fear but better government
representation and action.

Volunteers: Thanks to those of you who have signed up!
Remember, it is with no obligation on your part. We will put your contact
info on our volunteer list. From time to time, when we have emerging needs
for volunteers, we will send out an email to the list saying what we need.
If you can help with that, you reply directly to the email. If not, no
action needed on your part. No need to apologize or send a doctor’s note.
Easy-Peasy. To get on or make sure you are on the volunteer list, just
reply to this email with your preferred contact info.

If by chance, you would like to volunteer for a continuing
campaign role, let me know. We always need help with schedule planning,
social media coverage, and more. It’s all on your own time with a little
time for coordination.

We are doing all we can to get donations to make sure we have the
funds to put on a viable campaign. Many of you have already donated.
Thank you! To donate again or to help someone else donate, use my main
campaign website: https://www.linebergerforuscongress.com/
We are up against a lot. My opponent just reported that he
brought in $1.15M last quarter in donations to his campaign. His advantage
is that he supports the top 1% economically. Our advantage is that we
support everyone, so help spread the word.

Upcoming calendar events:

Friday, October 17th, 6-8 PM, Mark Nair for US House (CD13) – People First
Rally at Andersons Eatery and Distillery, Denton

Saturday, Oct 18th, No Kings protests nationwide. I plan to be at the
Frisco Event 9:30 – 11 and then the Flower Mound Event from 2 – 4 PM.
There are events in Denton, Dallas, Garland, Arlington, and many more. Use
this Link to find the one(s) that suit you.
https://www.mobilize.us/nokings/?tag_ids=27849

Monday, October 20th, 5:30 – 8:30 PM, Candidate Forum at UNT, Denton,
Student Union Jade Ballroom

Early Voting: Oct 20 – 31, 2025 – Put out your Ernest Lineberger Signs at
polling locations

Election Day: November 4, 2025 – Retrieve your Ernest Lineberger signs

Early November: We should hear the court’s decision about redistricting.
Will we be using the 2024 district boundaries or the newer and more
gerrymandered ones from the recent Texas special session.

Saturday, November 8th, 9:30 – 11 Amish, Little Elm Veterans Walk, Ernest
to speak

Sunday, November 9th, 2-4 PM, Texas Dem AG Debate, plus Colin Allred
interview by Denton Together and UNT DEMs at the UNT Lyceum Theater

November 11 – 12, TBD on more Veterans events

If you live in Lewisville ISD, Michelle Alkhatib is our preferred candidate
for School Board. She has been a great school Board member and is running
again. Her opponent is a late entry backed by a right-wing group that
doesn’t like Michelle’s last name.

If you live in Texas, we have 17 constitutional amendments. I recommend
that you pre-print your sample ballot. Use link:
https://www.lonestarleft.com/p/texas-2025-constitutional-amendments to help
make your decisions. This link leaves some recommendations “neutral”.
Some of the County Democratic Parties have lists that are similar with
minor differences.

Thank you so much for your continued support! We are building to make the
2026 election fall in the favor of the people.

Putting People’s Needs First!
Ernest Lineberger
Democratic Candidate for US House of Representatives (Texas CD26)
LinebergerforUScongress.com
Check out my book on Amazon.com, ‘There I Was...:Life Memories from Ernest
Lineberger

# [](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/67?t=1&akid=5055%2E35263%2Ew1bEax)
Peter, did you hear what GOP House Speaker Mike Johnson just said about Democrats’ plan to keep health insurance affordable? He called it _“a boondoggle.”_ Millions of people could lose the financial help they need to keep their Affordable Care Act policies at the end of the year. Instead of working with Democrats to fix that, Republicans have shut down the government. Now _that’s_ a boondoggle. As a child, I was uninsured because of a severe illness that put me in the hospital for three months. Even after I recovered, my family couldn’t get health insurance for me because of that previous illness. The ACA fixed that, making sure health insurance companies cannot deny coverage based on pre-existing conditions. But it can only help when people can afford to be insured. **I know what it’s like to not have health care coverage. That’s why I’m fighting to make sure Republicans don’t take away yours.** Trump and the Republican Congress don’t want to protect people with pre-existing conditions. They don’t care if you lose your insurance. I do. That's why I won’t stop fighting for Wisconsinites and all Americans to have affordable health care coverage. **[Flipping the Senate blue is the best way to put a check on the Trump administration and show them we’re fighting to protect health care in this country. name: Eric Sorensen
subject: We have No Kings in America
body:
|
# [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/117473102/576595126/795475316?refcode=em-header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS85MzkwNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5MmM2MGY0NS03OWFiLWYwMTEtOGU2MS02MDQ1YmRlZDhiYTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=lJmPPGMf8HynbDzSbS7BQKdWYm-IaKx1R8wwbkdtxM4=)
Peter, In America, we don’t have kings – that’s what our founding was all about! – and we certainly won’t bend to the knee for people trying to change that. Earlier this summer, I joined active, concerned Americans in my district to make clear that we don’t stand for kings here. And this weekend, I’m proud to be joining with the community again. **Trump and his allies want us discouraged. But Saturday is just one moment in our fight to restore our country from these extremists. There are battles ahead and we need everyone involved and engaged in their own way.** I’m moved by the millions of people who will be actively standing up and speaking out over the direction this administration is trying to take our democracy, and the ways this administration is trying to undermine the very Constitution they swore an oath to serve. And I hope you'll stick with this fight as we continue to deliver for IL-17 and the country. Right now, that means making sure we have a Congress that can curb the worst impulses of Trump and the far-right. | | Hi Peter, **We’re here to tell you about a concrete action you can take, in just a couple of minutes, to help protect voting rights and stop political insiders from rigging our democracy.** Trump allies are trying to pressure an independent government board — the Election Assistance Commission (EAC) — into enacting **a new voter suppression policy**. This voter suppression scheme would make it harder for millions of eligible Americans to register to vote. The proposal would force Americans to show specific, costly, hard-to-access documents like passports before registering to vote. An **estimated 21 million Americans** could be **shut out from the ballot box** , particularly rural folks, students, women, and communities of color... while clearing the way for the wealthy and well-connected to call the shots. **Right now, the EAC is taking public comments — from people like you — to gather input on whether they should adopt this anti-voter initiative. They need to hear from our movement about how damaging this policy would be before they make their decision. And it only takes a couple of minutes to make your voice heard.** [**Click here to leave your comment and speak out against this proposed barrier to the voter registration process. You can say something like this — or personalize it (that helps!):**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/117473117/576595201/-847851428?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNS8xLzkwOTg3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjc5NDE1ZDY1LTc5YWItZjAxMS04ZTYxLTYwNDViZGVkOGJhNCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=DVxyoIyZVPtxpgf4WYp4tMK35N2_Ez5nky6uagViA8s=&emci=4eb14ad8-75ab-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&emdi=79415d65-79ab-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&ceid=14405814) _This rule change would require Americans to present specific, expensive government documents like passports to register to vote. It's being sold as "election security" but it’s a trick. Citizenship is already required by law and an estimated 21 million citizens lack ready access to these documents. This only creates unnecessary barriers that will burden eligible voters, particularly from rural communities, women who've changed their last name, and working families. I oppose this rule change. This isn’t about “election security.” It’s a deliberate power grab attempt to silence voters._ The proposal comes from a right-wing organization founded by Stephen Miller, a key figure behind some of the MAGA movement’s most extreme, harmful policies. **It’s all part of an effort to subvert our democracy by suppressing the vote.** And far-right groups have been mobilizing their supporters to leave comments in favor of their new proposed barrier to voter registration. They want it to _look_ like the American people are uniformly behind the policy — **so** **we have to speak out and make it clear that we oppose it.** Every comment helps! [**Tell the EAC not to require Americans to show costly documents before registering to vote — you can help protect democracy by making your voice heard right now.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/117473118/576595202/-847851428?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNS8xLzkwOTg3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjc5NDE1ZDY1LTc5YWItZjAxMS04ZTYxLTYwNDViZGVkOGJhNCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=DVxyoIyZVPtxpgf4WYp4tMK35N2_Ez5nky6uagViA8s=&emci=4eb14ad8-75ab-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&emdi=79415d65-79ab-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&ceid=14405814) Every comment matters. name: Ro Khanna
subject: BREAKING: I just introduced a Constitutional Amendment with Rep. Jackson, guaranteeing the right to vote.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Ro for Congress
body:
https://rokhanna.com [https://rokhanna.com]
Peter,
BREAKING NEWS: Rep. Jonathan Jackson and I just introduced a Constitutional Amendment to restore checks and balances, to make clear that no president can legislate by decree or erase hard-won protections like the Voting Rights Act.
Before I explain, will you sign our petition to make the right to vote a permanent, guaranteed part of our Constitution? [https://act.rokhanna.com/a/right-to-vote-amendment-petition?contactdata=cajXJcaU0vXzU0fF49XkPdTBLXT9kDkBjG9cwuMLp3UoLawlpvUK5br0dSWgAauYhr9x90ev3qBXo+94AGemI1gMQcfAWkv0Ys1icIYcHq57epo7roHNeFDUPgfK4oPDAdAJVopX7YECZtKbQtVUcxQsKOkz7N6SY/YXW+of0Y14qREkeCtOXDuJBTTO+X7S]
This week, the Supreme Court heard Louisiana v. Callais, a case that could erase what remains of the Voting Rights Act of 1965.
At stake is whether millions of Black Americans in Louisiana and across the South will keep the ability to elect representatives who truly reflect their communities or whether decades of civil-rights progress will vanish under the false banner of “colorblind” politics.
At the same time, Donald Trump and his allies are pushing an unprecedented expansion of presidential power that would let the White House rewrite laws and sideline Congress entirely.
https://x.com/RoKhanna/status/1978805113901760902 [https://x.com/RoKhanna/status/1978805113901760902]
TAKE ACTION: Add your name to defend the Voting Rights Act and support my amendment to stop power grabs. [https://act.rokhanna.com/a/right-to-vote-amendment-petition?contactdata=cajXJcaU0vXzU0fF49XkPdTBLXT9kDkBjG9cwuMLp3UoLawlpvUK5br0dSWgAauYhr9x90ev3qBXo+94AGemI1gMQcfAWkv0Ys1icIYcHq57epo7roHNeFDUPgfK4oPDAdAJVopX7YECZtKbQtVUcxQsKOkz7N6SY/YXW+of0Y14qREkeCtOXDuJBTTO+X7S]
Louisiana’s history tells us exactly what happens when voting rights are stripped away. “Color-blind” laws once justified poll taxes and literacy tests, and now they’re being used again to silence Black voters.
We can’t let that happen again.
Our democracy only works when every American has a real voice, and when no president can change the rules to entrench power.
Join me now: Stand up for the Voting Rights Act and for our Constitution. [https://act.rokhanna.com/a/right-to-vote-amendment-petition?contactdata=cajXJcaU0vXzU0fF49XkPdTBLXT9kDkBjG9cwuMLp3UoLawlpvUK5br0dSWgAauYhr9x90ev3qBXo+94AGemI1gMQcfAWkv0Ys1icIYcHq57epo7roHNeFDUPgfK4oPDAdAJVopX7YECZtKbQtVUcxQsKOkz7N6SY/YXW+of0Y14qREkeCtOXDuJBTTO+X7S]
ADD YOUR NAME [https://act.rokhanna.com/a/right-to-vote-amendment-petition?contactdata=cajXJcaU0vXzU0fF49XkPdTBLXT9kDkBjG9cwuMLp3UoLawlpvUK5br0dSWgAauYhr9x90ev3qBXo+94AGemI1gMQcfAWkv0Ys1icIYcHq57epo7roHNeFDUPgfK4oPDAdAJVopX7YECZtKbQtVUcxQsKOkz7N6SY/YXW+of0Y14qREkeCtOXDuJBTTO+X7S]
Thank you for standing for democracy and equality.
In solidarity,
Ro
Wait! One more thing–
Ro doesn't accept a cent from lobbyists or PACs, meaning our work is completely funded by grassroots supporters like you. By donating just $3 today, you’re helping us create a country that works for everyone, not just those at the top. # Trump refiles his $15 billion dollar lawsuit against the New York Times
President Donald Trump refiled his **[staggering $15 billion defamation lawsuit](https://substack.com/redirect/2bbf84b9-0cc2-4e2e-8261-231d8d933ce1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/2bbf84b9-0cc2-4e2e-8261-231d8d933ce1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)Thursday against The New York Times and its reporters in Florida federal court, just weeks after a judge tossed the original as overly verbose, alleging vicious smears on his business empire and TV fame that demand massive reparations.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/cd7b8444-979b-42d2-9483-3b427ad18cd1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Original Complaint Dismissed Harshly** : Federal Judge Steven Merryday axed Trump's initial 85-page filing last month for flouting rules on brevity, slamming it as a "tedious" evidence dump laced with superfluous praise for the plaintiff.
* **Amended Suit Targets Key Figures** : The slimmed-down 40-page complaint zeroes in on reporters Susanne Craig, Russ Buettner, and Peter Baker, plus book publisher Penguin Random House.
* **Core Claims Hit Pulitzer-Winning Probes** : The suit blasts 2024 Times articles and the expose book "Lucky Loser" for fabricating Trump's "fact-free" rise via tax dodges and "The Apprentice" hype, seeking punitive damages atop the $15B tab.
* **Media Giant Vows Defiant Stand** : The Times has dismissed the refiling as meritless intimidation for "independent reporting," amid Trump's barrage of suits against outlets like ABC, CBS, and WSJ over alleged smears and election meddling.

# **Trump slashes IVF costs, Baby Boom incoming**
President Donald Trump **[unveiled two initiatives Thursday](https://substack.com/redirect/9ed6689b-e231-4088-8b94-ff08458bfec1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** to dramatically lower in vitro fertilization drug prices and boost employer coverage, fulfilling a campaign vow amid soaring U.S. fertility treatment costs exceeding $20,000 per cycle.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/51c66fb5-316f-401d-8e55-2a9891101d50?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* **Fertility Drug Prices Slashed** : Trump struck a deal with EMD Serono to cut costs on key IVF medications, trading tariff relief for the German firm's imported pharmaceuticals.
* **Employer Benefits Guidance Issued** : The administration urged insurance companies to add voluntary fertility coverage like dental plans, at fixed low costs, though adoption remains optional.
* **Affordability Crisis Spotlighted** : IVF cycles cost 271% more in U.S. than abroad, with only 25% of large firms covering it, fueling broad public support across parties.

# Regional Banks have a brutal day on Wall Street over credit and loan worries
Wall Street's **[regional banks plunged Thursday](https://substack.com/redirect/4954fefa-9ce4-4ebb-b4a5-6fb2444a1793?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** as Zions Bancorporation and Western Alliance Bancorp revealed massive bad loan charges and fraud allegations respectively, sparking fears of a broader crisis in the opaque private credit market amid auto industry bankruptcies.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/4954fefa-9ce4-4ebb-b4a5-6fb2444a1793?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Zions Faces Heavy Charges** : Zions Bancorporation announced sizable write-downs Wednesday evening for loans to multiple borrowers, triggering over 10% midday stock drop on Thursday and amplifying sector-wide jitters.
* **Western Alliance Uncovers Fraud** : Western Alliance accused a borrower of fraud Thursday, leading to a more than 9% share decline and heightening scrutiny on lending oversight in regional institutions.
* **Jefferies Exposure Deepens Woes** : Jefferies shares sank over 7% with $715 million tied to bankrupt First Brands, marking a 23% monthly loss and its worst performance since 2020.
* **Dimon Warns of Hidden Risks** : JPMorgan CEO Jamie Dimon likened emerging loan failures to spotting "one cockroach," signaling potential excesses in private credit that could threaten broader banking stability.
* **JPM Analyst 's Echo Their Boss: **In a note to clients,[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/4954fefa-9ce4-4ebb-b4a5-6fb2444a1793?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[reported by CNBC](https://substack.com/redirect/4954fefa-9ce4-4ebb-b4a5-6fb2444a1793?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** ,**** JPMorgan banking analyst Anthony Elian said:****_" While we are questioning why all of these credit 'one offs' are seemingly occurring in a short period of time, the reality is that even though these exposures may be 'well-contained' and have a 'limited financial impact,' this is an industry where investors -- especially those that are new to this sector -- tend to 'sell first and ask questions later,' especially when it comes to elevated credit concerns,"_

# What AI Bubble? Oracle announces a billion dollar mega deal with Meta
In a blockbuster blowout at its Las Vegas AI conference Thursday, Oracle unveiled a **[$20 billion cloud pact with Meta Platforms](https://substack.com/redirect/f812c89f-2db7-4056-9c75-5df2b2fd68c1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** to supercharge AI infrastructure, fueling a 5% stock surge and spotlighting the tech titans' frantic race for computing supremacy amid soaring AI demands.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/f812c89f-2db7-4056-9c75-5df2b2fd68c1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Deal Value Hits $20 Billion** : Oracle's massive cloud-computing contract with Meta, part of seven deals totaling $65 billion from four clients, excluding prior OpenAI pacts, signal Oracle's attempt to diversify beyond a single hyperscaler dependencies.
* **AI Revenue Skyrockets Projected** : Core database and AI platform businesses are eyeing $20 billion in fiscal 2030 revenue, leaping from $2.4 billion this year and $3 billion next, driven by easing supply chains in coming years despite concerns.
* **Stargate Project Accelerates Buildout** : Oracle is teaming with OpenAI and SoftBank on U.S.-wide data centers starting in Abilene, Texas, boasting 30-40% margins after infrastructure costs.
* **Supply Surge Fuels Growth** : Executives hail "immense demand" for AI hardware, with improved availability post-2026 enabling rapid contract fulfillment and positioning Oracle to challenge Amazon and Google in the booming cloud arena.

# Gas prices tumble nationally and expectations are they will stay there
The **[national gas price average has tumbled](https://substack.com/redirect/d092d0d2-b1b6-4739-a54d-c6715c10707f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** to $3.07 per gallon amid post-summer demand slump, with experts forecasting a sub-$3 plunge nationwide for the first time in years as refineries shift to cheaper winter blends.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/d092d0d2-b1b6-4739-a54d-c6715c10707f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **National average hits new low** : The pricer is down 10 cents from last month and 15 cents from a year ago, reflecting broad declines across more than 40 states per AAA data.
* **Regional extremes starkly visible** : Texas leads the lows at $2.65/gallon, while California's $4.65 average burdens West Coast drivers amid varying state taxes and supply factors.
* **Oil barrel plunge accelerates drop** : Crude oil prices, dipping below $60 a barrel has helped the trend, with predictions of sustained sub-$3 levels through winter.
* **Income relief boosts spending power** : Forecasts of future prices of gasoline expect it to drive gas expenditure below 2% of disposable income in 2025--the lowest since 2005--through a combination of rising wages and falling fuel costs.

Jefferies Exposure Deepens Woes : Jefferies shares sank over 7% with $715 million tied to bankrupt First Brands, marking a 23% monthly loss and its worst performance since 2020. clean_body: We’re closer than ever to taking back this Senate seat. | Fellow Conservative, The radical left thinks they can dismiss us, calling us“backward,” “extreme,” and worse. They’re attacking the Minnesota values I’ve spent a lifetime defending — faith, family, and freedom. But here’s the truth they don’t want you to know: we’re closer than ever to taking back this Senate seat. With the election fast approaching, attention is turning to Minnesota’s Senate race. My opponents, Tim Walz’s lieutenant governor, Peggy Flanagan, and Rep. Angie Craig, thought they had this seat locked up. But a recent poll they commissioned delivered a shock: Flanagan leads a generic Republican by just two points, and Craig by only four points. For the first time since 2008, Republicans have a genuine shot at flipping this seat for Minnesota conservatives and every American on the right. I’m Adam Schwarze, a former Navy SEAL Officer and Marine Corps veteran. I grew up on Minnesota’s hockey rinks, enlisted after 9/11, and served in over 70 countries, leading high-stakes missions with discipline and resolve. Service is my calling — to my country, my family, and now to you. I’m running for U.S. Senate to fight for the America we love, the one you’ve worked hard to build for your children and grandchildren. The left’s agenda — pushed by Flanagan and Craig — mocks our heritage, looks back on the chaos of 2020 with rose-colored glasses, and leaves our communities to pay the price. They expect us to stay silent. I know better — and so do you. Your legacy is on the line. This isn’t just an election; it’s a battle for the soul of our nation. I’m the underdog — a regular Minnesotan called to an extraordinary challenge. With your support, we can send a second Navy SEAL to the U.S. Senate to defend our values in Washington. I’m not asking for a free pass — I’m asking for your partnership. Every dollar fuels our fight to share my message with voters across Minnesota. Throughout my career, I have faced myriad challenges, but it’s clear to me that my greatest challenge will be earning your trust as I work to win a Senate seat in Minnesota. The left’s attacks won’t stop, and we need resources to fight back with the strength you expect from a Navy SEAL. Together, we can prove them wrong and show Minnesota — and America — that our values still matter. With deep gratitude Adam Schwarze Proud Marine Veteran Retired Navy SEAL Republican Candidate for U.S. Senate – Minnesota FOLLOW ADAM ON SOCIAL MEDIA | | Paid for by Schwarze for Senate Adam Schwarze is a former Navy SEAL and Marine. Since launching this campaign, I have visited communities all across the Commonwealth — from Farmville to Fairfax, Richmond to Roanoke — to hear directly from Virginians about the challenges they face.
_And that's informed what we communicate and how we spend our resources._
My opponent, Winsome Earle-Sears, has shown she's in lockstep with Trump's agenda. She downplayed the White House laying off thousands of Virginia workers by saying, "don't fret." And she boasted that Trump's disastrous tax law does "so many great things." _We're talking about a policy that cuts $1 trillion from Medicaid and slashes resources for public schools here._
I've given voters my word: **As Governor, I will always put them first and stand up to the chaos coming out of Washington.**
That's why I have announced my plans to grow our workforce and raise the minimum wage, to reduce the cost of childcare, and to make life more affordable from healthcare and prescription drugs to housing costs and utility bills.
With the limited time left in this campaign, I'm counting on a surge of grassroots donations to:
✅ Visit every corner of Virginia.
✅ Reach undecided voters with ads and counter the GOP's attacks.
✅ Build the largest organizing operation our Commonwealth's ever seen.
It's a major undertaking, but I know this team is not intimidated by hard work. No matter what the National Republicans throw at us, we'll be ready to respond.

Peter,

clean_body: | | | Peter, I grew up in a small, tight-knit community where my dad worked as a tax collector and union leader. He fought for fair pay and good benefits, not just for himself, but for everyone in his union. From him, I learned that when we stand together, we can make life better for working families. Those lessons are with me every single day. They guided me when I first ran for the legislature in a deep-red district and won - becoming Colorado’s first openly transgender lawmaker. As Vice Chair of the House Finance Committee and a member of the Appropriations Committee, I’ve had a front-row seat to the way Colorado invests in its future. Every day, I hear bills on a wide range of topics - from education and healthcare to transportation and housing - and I cast critical votes on how our state allocates its resources. Friend, this morning while I was peacefully protesting at an ICE processing facility, I was struck in the face by a baton. This is after following police instructions. I'm fine (besides a massive f*cking bruise), but my field director was arrested for exercising his First Amendment rights, alongside other peaceful protesters, including clergy. He’s out now and currently at an urgent care to ensure he is not concussed. **Anyone who kidnaps families in the middle of the night, beats peaceful protesters en masse, or arrests people for demonstrating freely ARE NOT THE GOOD GUYS.** We need more Democrats in Congress who will show up, put themselves in harm's way, and actually speak out against these atrocities. These are not normal times – we cannot have a "normal" response. **[This moment requires bold progressive leadership, and if you're sick of Democrats in Congress doing the bare minimum (and sometimes less than that), please join my team with a $1 contribution today.](https://ka4il.us/l/If2iQpQDxxRA) ** And if you can't or have already given what you're able, please do something kind for your neighbors today. In solidarity and wishing you safety, Kat Abughazaleh Friend, it's Kat Abughazaleh, and if this isn't a sign of what's to come, I don't know what is.
As always, if you'd like to receive fewer emails, click [**here**](https://ka4il.us/l/M5o53BbZ9qKz)**,** or if you'd like to unsubscribe from all future emails, click **here**.
**_Donald Trump is planning on attacking payment processor ActBlue in another attempt by his administration to push the limits of his power._**
The detainment of Mahmoud Kahlil, the deportation of Kilmar Abrego Garcia, and the outright denial to follow a ruling made by the Supreme Court are all blatant oversteps that attack our right to free speech and due process and challenge the rule of law.
Friend, I've spent years watching Fox News and listening to their rhetoric get more and more extreme, and Donald Trump is doing exactly what they want.
**_Fascism is, and has always been, their end goal._**
Their vision is one of a militarized country where only certain people—a few dozen rich men—have a seat at the table, and dissidents like me are silenced.
Trump and Elon know that progressive movements like ours are in the way because I've made it abundantly clear that strongly worded letters, wearing matching outfits while holding up signs, and meaningless acts of symbolism **aren't my thing.**
As a member of Congress, I'm going to be unwavering in my fight for our communities.
I will not vote for authoritarian bills in the name of "compromise," I will not abandon or demonize vulnerable groups to cater to the right, and I will not change my stances for fear of retaliation.
And Friend, that's what this action on ActBlue is: retaliation. Campaigns like ours rely on small dollars from people like you to support us, and ActBlue is integral to making that work.
[**If you can before you go, can you chip in (through ActBlue) to help us continue to fund mutual aid efforts and bring our unwavering commitment to the people of our district to Congress?**](https://ka4il.us/l/yPCJO0djsatc)

Kat has fought fascists before as a citizen, union rep, and independent journalist. Now, she's going to do the same in Congress. **Let's win this together.** **[Chip in!](https://ka4il.us/l/ZOfB5HuzBvBw)**

**The Democrats’ funding bill makes Americans unhealthy again** By Bobby Jindal and Hannah Anderson
---
The government shutdown threatens to give dead people Medicaid benefits.**** Yes, you read that correctly. The radical and partisan proposal to reopen the government insists on repealing the provisions of the “Working Families Tax Cut” legislation to ensure that the dollars, doctors, and care are diverted to the people most in need: _the recently deceased_. We’re being facetious, but you get the point. The radical Left was so desperate to fulfill its base’s wishes in giving healthcare to illegal immigrants that Democrats proposed repealing the full suite of pro-patient reforms in the WFTC bill, including the very commonsense measure of ensuring that states do not get ongoing federal funding for those no longer alive. The Department of Government Efficiency found 9.9 million Americans when investigating the number of deceased people still on Social Security’s database. States should do the same for Medicaid, ensuring that every dollar available goes to the most vulnerable Americans and is not lost to waste, fraud, and abuse. But it doesn’t end there. In their push to spend money on illegal immigrant healthcare, Democrats also repealed the groundbreaking Rural Health Transformation Fund. This fund, administered by the Department of Health and Human Services, makes a $50 billion capital investment into rural communities where there are roughly 30 doctors per 100,000 patients. Compare this with urban communities, which have 263 doctors per 100,000 patients. It is not America First to rob rural communities of life-saving funding in order to reopen the California loophole, using Medicaid to pay for the healthcare of illegal immigrants in the state. [**Finish reading at WashingtonExaminer.com**](http://links.americanxt.com/u/click?_t=45ea7b9dcedb45198104e7ca02a78270&_m=beb1b9388baa4306849eec13f8a17adc&_e=sR9onnv7siSl6rHCGhZ4LAgb76_rHlV4YYD1zbkqTeS-qxHd_Br-MQ7nSIft9RWPhsdLCRtgNuatYW_i-SJ9zZa5pgTvMCpQc8YI1j6WDya_Qbi2kaXRik_hTAPhhVSfUOZypxK17sqKaIkgvc7m7L4Nv4dHfc2lRE1sBRkZz8b9laVMey8Xa1S4TmOQ1Z3-zODVn3BUdlHUaBq7CqRkwOCJCcmJZgLUSJFo-bhAMzJ8u6G1NJdqNgjxVHyMOndkKRZ6kC_Em4XHMqY_4RlfWxB8nQ4jwHOKE2YI1ARzvKwO5d2E1j0MuF9ggIiWvWoOnBqrlMmmafC-z-4klLDtMapey58eTI6joSznRbM2IT8afJkBjTCPHlepTI30Cozjhxpze_dTTOyOBgRDk2sqSlXAuDI0wY5_R7OVT4B-8t5g1ShY5XcUCPx2hOe5KZ9mzVe-zcPVlknsnBEoq7AHdpIQAZ7cUO8M9-24Pkbi60ul6Rkq8OmyIFoVGco2HGPdwFr8kein68LijZ3BmrdSr1gGiZC74S885P-6i6B2PKcDVQborMGBtgGaerh4D2zhk0w02osiGkKQBpYHuuhiXrJI4HnxyPwXojczL4Ebz2F0q_WvjDGc5e4BT8EHaOsa)

**\---------- Forwarded message from Dr. Raul Ruiz ----------**
We’re now more than two weeks into this government shutdown, and I’ve got to be honest with you: **I’m furious**.
People are struggling. They’re confused, anxious, and scared. Families are missing paychecks. Some are worried about losing their coverage. Others are trying to figure out how they’ll afford their prescriptions next week.
As a doctor, I know what’s at stake when people lose access to care - they wait too long to see a doctor and miss catching cancer early when it is more curable, they have to choose between a medication they need and losing their home and savings, and they worry day and night about medical bills.
**This is unacceptable.**
I first ran for office because I believe everyone deserves access to care — no matter their zip code, their job, or their income. I will do everything in my power to stay in this fight.
But to keep fighting, I need your help. We’re almost a year away from the midterms, and your support is critical in helping me defend CA25.

My uncle is deploying the National Guard to American cities like Chicago and Los Angeles to advance his own political narrative of chaos and fear. He’s using the military as a prop, a tool of intimidation, and a stepping stone to unchecked power. This is what authoritarians do: They create a crisis, then position themselves as the only solution. They use force to silence dissent and normalize the militarization of our public life. It is a blatant and terrifying abuse of power, and it’s happening right now. The Democracy Defense Fund was created for this exact moment: to organize, to resist, and to win. Our strategy is clear, and it starts at the ground level. Our first line of defense is in the states. A pro-democracy governor has the power to reject this kind of dangerous federal overreach and protect the people of their state — and this November, we have the chance to elect Democratic governors in both Virginia and New Jersey. Our fight extends to this November’s state legislative races in Virginia, New Jersey, Louisiana, and Mississippi. Local majorities are the bedrock that will protect voting rights and block extreme agendas, building irreversible momentum to take back Congress in the 2026 midterms. This is a coordinated, long-term fight against tyranny, and we’re building from the ground up to tear Donald’s dangerous movement down. And we need your help, Peter. Many help set policy, oversee elections, and serve as a backstop against extremism. **That’s why I’m reaching out to ask you to join me in supporting Ghazala Hashmi in her race for Lieutenant Governor of Virginia. **"CARBON DUMP"** Crony corporations are using government subsidies (i.e. your tax dollars) to build pipelines all across the country. But these pipelines aren't carrying oil or gas, but the air you exhale--carbon dioxide. The scam includes using the force of government to take private property away from landowners through eminent domain, and then give it to these corporations to build the pipelines. The pipelines then take the CO2 from certain places, like ethanol plants, and bury it in the ground elsewhere. Our **South Dakota Freedom Caucus** shut down this scam in their state. The added benefit is that over a dozen liberal Republican lawmakers who supported the scheme were defeated in their primaries over this issue.Now it's Louisiana's turn. And your **Louisiana Freedom Caucus** is ready for the fight, claiming their state won't be used as a "carbon dump" for the Far Left's crazy desires.The LA Freedom Caucus recently announced its support for the Governor's moratorium on CO2 pipelines, but stated its intention that the moratorium needs to go much further to include several things, like more transparency and a complete prohibition on eminent domain abuse. Read the full press statement [here](http://give.statefreedomcaucus.org/ls/click?upn=u001.SSCAglCEkhp55PDWKhWTjj9y4Ze46-2F1zzYAfog6a1X6UvYYj2fCyEuogY1zi9-2B-2FVYGAaWEFndt7dQmuBBK4W5aE6zc00QiaruTU4IP9FGTX-2BpkTVWZGwFJNaBRaU9P5olOG0_9XnTPLnaEjN9OHWhKYUffDeECIVzR9M-2B5LaO5RH8NVBZyx1SQGGYhOdwcjZYtHerq4HGLtzF-2Fk8gTRqYNuSu2IOJbqHGixIfm-2FZcBDksCJ3HIZ7q09n3TKJeG2lRCeqniGK0gdMAcv7Y9Z9Ti7AgIAyQ2iTMVMcwMKnPXzo2xp6s9sIUkK3POa4wydd3yR5X7YDHHARhZddjuWzdaZMe04rtJ0Negopg5VDw2kMDNM-2F0Duq0Ju5h2uV7TC8UIroAKChm-2FVnyj5paDn1W2JmLipIi9EgNeCSf3BckkzTCLsr0j9J7CoWr5d6BRNfMSbh1).

**ILLEGAL ALIENS ON MARYLAND VOTER ROLLS** Your average Republican state lawmaker, at best, will vote conservatively but do little else to advance the cause of freedom. At worst, they conspire with Democrats to grow government.**What separates State Freedom Caucus members from these wayward Republicans?** State lawmakers are highly organized under the Freedom Caucus banner and they doggedly pursue their goal for limited government and more liberty.Case in point: Most Republican state lawmakers in Maryland have ignored or given brief lip service to the fact that an illegal alien was found on the state's voter rolls. But it was the **Maryland Freedom Caucus** that broke the story in the first place and are seeking accountability. They teamed up with our close ally - the **American Accountability Foundation** \--to demand answers from the Democrats who are in charge of elections in the state. In a recent news report, AAF President Tom Jones said, "I guarantee that there are hundreds, if not thousands of illegal aliens registered to vote in Maryland."Maryland Freedom Caucus members, Delegates Matt Morgan and Ryan Nawrocki, were also featured in the report. clean_body: | | | | Dear Friend, This week brings two new terms into your conservative lexicon - "TransRepublicans" and "Carbon Dump". Plus a couple of other stories.Let's get into it. | "TRANSREPUBLICANS" Oklahoma Freedom Caucus Chairman Shane Jett received a lot of attention on social media this week when he called his liberal Republican colleagues in the state legislature "TransRepublicans". If the shoe fits! This is worth watching. | "CARBON DUMP" Crony corporations are using government subsidies (i.e. your tax dollars) to build pipelines all across the country. But these pipelines aren't carrying oil or gas, but the air you exhale--carbon dioxide. The scam includes using the force of government to take private property away from landowners through eminent domain, and then give it to these corporations to build the pipelines. The pipelines then take the CO2 from certain places, like ethanol plants, and bury it in the ground elsewhere. Our South Dakota Freedom Caucus shut down this scam in their state. The added benefit is that over a dozen liberal Republican lawmakers who supported the scheme were defeated in their primaries over this issue.Now it's Louisiana's turn. And your Louisiana Freedom Caucus is ready for the fight, claiming their state won't be used as a "carbon dump" for the Far Left's crazy desires.The LA Freedom Caucus recently announced its support for the Governor's moratorium on CO2 pipelines, but stated its intention that the moratorium needs to go much further to include several things, like more transparency and a complete prohibition on eminent domain abuse. Read the full press statement . | ILLEGAL ALIENS ON MARYLAND VOTER ROLLS Your average Republican state lawmaker, at best, will vote conservatively but do little else to advance the cause of freedom. At worst, they conspire with Democrats to grow government.What separates State Freedom Caucus members from these wayward Republicans? State lawmakers are highly organized under the Freedom Caucus banner and they doggedly pursue their goal for limited government and more liberty.Case in point: Most Republican state lawmakers in Maryland have ignored or given brief lip service to the fact that an illegal alien was found on the state's voter rolls. But it was the Maryland Freedom Caucus that broke the story in the first place and are seeking accountability. They teamed up with our close ally - the American Accountability Foundation \--to demand answers from the Democrats who are in charge of elections in the state. In a recent news report, AAF President Tom Jones said, "I guarantee that there are hundreds, if not thousands of illegal aliens registered to vote in Maryland."Maryland Freedom Caucus members, Delegates Matt Morgan and Ryan Nawrocki, were also featured in the report. Watch more . | HONORING CHARLIE KIRK Illinois Freedom Caucus 's State Rep. Adam Niemerg honored Charlie Kirk--an Illinois native--on the state house floor this week for what would have been Charlie's 32nd birthday. Watch . | HELP US GROW With autumn upon us, now is the time to double down on growing our movement. Now is the time to help us expand into new states, while keeping our current states strong, and turn up the heat on the most pressing issues facing America. Every dollar counts and helps us ramp up pressure and ensure freedom flourishes across the country—especially now. Can we count on your support today? Together, we’ll turn up the heat—and the momentum. We'll be back with another update next week. Until then, please be sure to our efforts so that we can support our State Freedom Caucuses!In Liberty, Andy RothPresident State Freedom Caucus Network | |

This week Donald Trump attacked Jon from the Oval Office and said Jon’s _“whole philosophy is a disaster...”_ 🤔

Is it that Jon is leading the charge to expose corruption and abuse in government?
Or is it because Jon is one of few United States Senators who refuses to accept campaign contributions from corporate PACs or federal lobbyists?
Maybe it’s because Jon has introduced legislation to ban corporate PACs altogether — and is leading the charge to ban stock trading by Members of Congress.
_Peter, here’s the truth:_ Jon’s “philosophy” scares Donald Trump — _because getting big money out of politics and rooting out corruption in our government actually would be a disaster**for him.**_
Trump (and his MAGA friends) are using the office of the Presidency to enrich themselves in a way we have never, ever seen in American history.
**And they are determined to eliminate anyone who challenges their corruption or tries to stand in their way.**
That’s why Donald Trump went on the record and attacked Jon. And that’s why MAGA Republicans are going to spend hundreds of millions of dollars to try to flip Jon’s seat red.
We know this team has what it takes to reelect Jon so he can continue his important work in the Senate, but we can’t build a winning campaign that can withstand Trump’s attacks without you.

name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: So much for “America First”
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
You might be losing your health care, but don’t worry — Trump is sending $20 billion to Argentina’s right-wing government.

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=2681%2E4032634%2ECS-Sej)
---
Donald Trump and Republicans in Congress shut down our government because they don’t want to lower health care costs for the American people. Afterward, Trump said that if Democrats don't bend the knee and let him take health care away, he's just going to turn around and inflict punishment by illegally firing American workers and withholding funding from states he doesn’t like. **That’s not governing. That’s a wannabe king taking hostages.** Since day one Trump has always been trying to shut down the parts of government he doesn’t like. He gutted government agencies like the Department of Education. He fired thousands of federal workers doing essential jobs. He slashed funding for cancer, Alzheimer’s, and global vaccine research. He cancelled funding for PBS and NPR. He took funding from Medicaid and SNAP and gave it to billionaires. He’s tried to illegally erase millions of dollars for programs Congress already approved. And now he has pushed the country into a government shutdown over his desire to make health care more expensive. But make no mistake: Trump is still executing government functions and spending a lot of your taxpayer money during this shutdown — just not on anything that will actually help people. During the shutdown, Trump announced that he’s sending $20 billion of American taxpayer dollars to bail out Argentina’s far-right government. As if that wasn’t enough, he just directed U.S. banks to divert ANOTHER $20 billion away from lending to American businesses, farmers, and families to prop up Milei's corrupt presidency and failing economy. And oh — did you think that construction on Trump’s $200 million ballroom at the White House would stop because of the shutdown? No, it’s continuing uninterrupted, even as critical government services are suspended and essential employees like TSA agents and air traffic controllers aren’t getting paid. **That’s right. You might be losing your health care, and the government might be shut down, but don’t worry — Trump is hard at work sending billions of taxpayer dollars to Argentina and wining and dining the billionaire class to build his new ballroom.** And who’s paying the price? The American people, who are already fighting to stay afloat as costs skyrocket under Trump’s economy. **So much for “America First.”** Trump thinks he can write checks to his far-right friends in Argentina, give tax breaks to his billionaire buddies, bully any news outlet that’s critical of him, and take money away from communities. Put simply, he thinks he can reign like a king over Americans. But Americans don’t bow to any king ([**speaking of, you can find a No Kings rally near you this Saturday here**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/3176?t=15&akid=2681%2E4032634%2ECS-Sej)). This is the kind of stuff that petty tyrants and insecure dictators do — not the President of the United States. I won’t stand for it, and I’ll keep fighting to expose Trump’s corruption and hold him accountable for breaking the law and putting his billionaire donors and foreign right-wing leaders above the American people. Thanks for being a part of this, Elizabeth | Elizabeth is fighting Trump’s corruption and grift every day in the Senate. This movement is grassroots-funded. Will you help Elizabeth continue fighting for working people — not billionaires and giant corporations — with a contribution today? | [**DONATE**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/3178?t=16&akid=2681%2E4032634%2ECS-Sej)

| | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/117482315/576625811/2051259084?amount=5&source=SBD_AD_EM_FR_101725_Flanagan_30DO_D1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NzIyMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyNDRlMzVmZi04Y2FiLWYwMTEtOGU2MS02MDQ1YmRlZDhiYTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=AYRCljmcJtT0Fft5yBh6f5bx4ZangZJCdDzK-gRYcsU=) Peter, When I first ran for the Minneapolis School Board, I didn’t think we would win. I thought we would stand up for our community and share important concerns. But I never imagined how many of my neighbors shared those concerns. While I was running, I met an old woman at a public housing complex for urban native communities. She was selling frybread – and had a little Folgers coffee can where everyone was putting in $5. After we spoke, she took $5 out, put it in my hand, and wrapped her finger around it. She told me: “My girl, we’re so proud of you.” **That $5 meant more to me than a giant check from someone I knew could afford it.** I’m running for Senate to give back to the communities that have given me so much. I want to be the voice for Minnesota families in Washington. And folks know it. This is a grassroots campaign, powered by normal Minnesota families chipping in $5 or $10 at a time. Since our launch, our average contribution has been just $25. Some people give more, some people give less. But I am honored and humbled by every donation. **[Please, split a donation to my campaign for the U.S. Senate with PA Lt. Gov. If you’d like to unsubscribe, | | = Peter, When I first ran for the Minneapolis School Board, I didn’t think we would win. I thought we would stand up for our community and share important concerns. But I never imagined how many of my neighbors shared those concerns. While I was running, I met an old woman at a public housing complex for urban native communities. She was selling frybread – and had a little Folgers coffee can where everyone was putting in $5. After we spoke, she took $5 out, put it in my hand, and wrapped her finger around it. She told me: “My girl, we’re so proud of you.” That $5 meant more to me than a giant check from someone I knew could afford it. I’m running for Senate to give back to the communities that have given me so much. I want to be the voice for Minnesota families in Washington. And folks know it. This is a grassroots campaign, powered by normal Minnesota families chipping in $5 or $10 at a time. Since our launch, our average contribution has been just $25. name: Gov. Andy Beshear
subject: Federal workers are not bargaining chips.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by In This Together PAC
body:
Enough is ENOUGH!
Peter,

Right now, our federal government is shut down because Congress failed to do its most basic job: Pass a budget to keep our government programs fully funded.

Critical services like food assistance programs are being directly impacted. Hundreds of thousands of federal workers — _including more than 20,000 right here in Kentucky_ — have been furloughed or are working without pay. **And now, Donald Trump is directing federal agencies to start laying workers off.**

Republicans and Democrats in Washington are negotiating over how to fund the government; specifically, they disagree over whether or not to lower health insurance premiums for American families. That negotiation has led to the government shutting down. But it did not lead to workers being fired. **If the President chooses to fire federal employees, that is because he and he alone chose to do so. People are not props, and the President of the United States shouldn’t be treating them that way.**

I've met workers and their families across the Commonwealth who are affected by this shutdown. They're our neighbors, our friends, and our family members. They're the people who keep our communities safe, our air clean, our food inspected, and our borders secure.

This shutdown shows some of the worst parts of our politics — from a refusal to negotiate to find a solution that works for the American people, to the Trump Administration’s willingness to use people as bargaining chips in order to try to win a negotiation.

We need leaders who care about their people, and who will put the people they represent over the party they’re registered with.

clean_body: Enough is ENOUGH! Peter, Right now, our federal government is shut down because Congress failed to do its most basic job: Pass a budget to keep our government programs fully funded. Critical services like food assistance programs are being directly impacted. Hundreds of thousands of federal workers — including more than 20,000 right here in Kentucky — have been furloughed or are working without pay. And now, Donald Trump is directing federal agencies to start laying workers off. Republicans and Democrats in Washington are negotiating over how to fund the government; specifically, they disagree over whether or not to lower health insurance premiums for American families. That negotiation has led to the government shutting down. But it did not lead to workers being fired. If the President chooses to fire federal employees, that is because he and he alone chose to do so. People are not props, and the President of the United States shouldn’t be treating them that way. I've met workers and their families across the Commonwealth who are affected by this shutdown. They're our neighbors, our friends, and our family members. They're the people who keep our communities safe, our air clean, our food inspected, and our borders secure. This shutdown shows some of the worst parts of our politics — from a refusal to negotiate to find a solution that works for the American people, to the Trump Administration’s willingness to use people as bargaining chips in order to try to win a negotiation. We need leaders who care about their people, and who will put the people they represent over the party they’re registered with. That's why I started In This Together PAC in the first place: To elect leaders who will fight for the American people, not use them as leverage. name: Marjorie Taylor Greene
subject: I am being smeared by the Uniparty
body:
They are trying to break me.
| | | | Friend, I am under attack from all sides.
The Fake News media, the Communist Democrats, even the sellouts in my own party who’ve joined the Uniparty....
**They are all trying to break me.**
They’ve painted a target on my back - twisting my words, smearing my name, and working around the clock on hit pieces like these to intimidate me:
---
[](https://link.email.greene4congress.)
The entrenched elitists in our nation’s capital are calling in every favor to discredit me and make me go away because I’m committed to exposing what the Swamp has spent years trying to hide.
Unfortunately for them, I will not back down and I am hot on their trail.
* **I’m leading the charge to reveal the full Jeffrey Epstein list.**
* **I’m calling out AIPAC for buying influence in Congress and telling the truth about what is happening in Gaza.**
* **I’m fighting to stop your tax dollars from being wasted on senseless foreign wars and Radical Left policies.**
* **I am making sure the GOP delivers the America First agenda that President Trump promised to the American People.**

I will never give up these fights because Americans expect their representatives in Congress to be their voice in government. I am committed to being that voice for my voters in Georgia who want their representatives in DC to clean up our corrupt government and fight for policies that put America First.
But there are too many Swamp creatures who are determined to see me fall. They benefit from government corruption and our nation’s decline and they want to crush me publicly so no one like me ever dares to defy them again.
Here’s what I need to know right now: **Do you still stand with me?**
I am going through the fire and I need to know who my top supporters are.
Friend, the media rags attacking me want the country to believe that all of my supporters have abandoned me. They want to spread the lie that support for the pillars of the MAGA movement is faltering.
**_I don’t believe them for one second and I intend to send a message._**
**_[So if you still have my back then please add your name to my letter of support today and send a message that America First is here to stay](https://link.email.greene4congress.)_****.**
[](https://link.email.greene4congress.)
[SIGN: I Still Stand With MTG](https://link.email.greene4congress.)
**Friend, I will not be intimidated but I need my strongest supporters ready for what’s next.**
Not only am I fighting smear campaigns on multiple fronts but Leftist radicals who hate our movement have even threatened my life in a desperate attempt to silence me.
So please, once you’ve added your name, I hope you’ll take the next step.
**_[After you add your name, please chip in $10, $25, or whatever you can afford on the following page to help me ensure my campaign’s security push back against this nonstop onslaught](https://link.email.greene4congress.)_.**
[Stand With MTG](https://link.email.greene4congress.)
I’ve been attacked in every way possible. Political, personal, even physical.
They’ll keep coming but with your support we will prove that America First conservatives will never bow to their thuggery.
The Swamp is counting on you to stay quiet. _Prove them wrong_.
_Yours in the fight,_
| | [](https://link.email.greene4congress.)
---
**Marjorie Taylor Greene**
[](https://link.email.greene4congress.)

I'm not saying I'm obsessed with Coke Zero, Peter, but...

This summer, on those sweltering Iowa days on the campaign trail, a nice cold can of Coke Zero from Casey’s felt like pure magic after hours of talking to Iowans and knocking on doors.

If I had to guess how much I've spent on Coke Zero over the years..._well, let's just say it's definitely more than I'd like to admit._ One can of Coke Zero costs around $2 — doesn't seem like much, but it adds up.

And that's what I've been thinking about lately. The small things we do day-to-day all add up to make a big difference over time. And it's this incremental effort that wins elections.

**If I'm honest, Mariannette Miller-Meeks isn't exactly someone I'd want to share a Coke with.** Time and again, she's sided with wealthy donors and party insiders instead of the people right here in Iowa. Our district deserves better, someone who listens, who shows up, who you could actually imagine sitting down with on the porch and cracking open a Coke together.

Peter, **Millions of people are expected to take to the streets tomorrow in protest of the authoritarian Trump administration for a massive No Kings protest.** Donald Trump has abused his executive power at every turn—silencing dissent, breaking the law, terrorizing and deporting people en masse—and the Supreme Court is doing everything in its power to help him. **But We the People know there are no kings in America—Not in the White House, not even if they wear robes.** The constitution doesn’t belong to a wannabe dictator. It doesn’t belong to corrupt Supreme Court justices. It belongs to the people. And we can protect our democracy if we stand up and fight back. **We’ll be out in streets across the country this Saturday. And the latest update is that we’ll all be wearing yellow. Join us!** [****](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.XaF8mXqsA6b2dSPmhsleMbIwXrUx9efdTq_vbf4FLD27L3aJZ766y3MaCay2AIbg/4kt/vvfOPZLYSA2Z_AYfZmeVyw/h0/h001.fkMTZYgMPqyXZVtcoObYXiNAwttSTAc4nldouBmOPmw) [**We can’t win if we don’t fight. ## 80-Year-Old Breaks Ironman Record
Natalie Grabow of New Jersey made history Saturday as the [oldest woman to finish](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkD1uhDAUhE9jOiPbGLwULtLQbdqU6IEf8BL_IONdtLePiPYGKWdGGs03X_fxDuQprp8Q0C7rMpYljRHPw2MpmEfKKQaIa4boAqwEsQTwEB6jEqrlUnBpRgfkX2NbObsgKmwqtNJ0wjRKCFNt1ty6uZc49ZOSc9PKWavp5nR3AwFGd31F9mqTQholZKPaelqkgEn3k8ZeYtMxLdBRSbn-ThTLhot_pSfmek6h8nYrZT9Y88HUwNRwnmddMiltrpipoWSCsvkU-UXG1AAr8jWnx87UEKGAp0vDlE5-puwdzzin7Pib_m3OG4SdUjw22vlPilBl6_aTvKejM0yLNQD5v0nl318-rfoNAAD__4-0jMY) the Ironman World Championship in Kona, Hawaii, completing the grueling course in 16 hours and 45 minutes at age 80. It was her 10th time racing in Kona, and she topped the women's 80-84 division after qualifying at Ironman Maryland earlier this year. Grabow picked up triathlons in her 60s and says her secret is [racing with gratitude](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkTuu3DoQRFdDZRyQrQ9HgYJ5eJCjawcOHAqtYUtsmx-B5Fxhdm_I8A6cHaCAAurUj4_lA9lz3L9ioGnbt6VuaYl0Fk-1Ul44pxgw7hmjDbgzxhrQY3gtoKCXWkltFovs30vf2GkjAmobmrQZlGlBKdO4abA93EfTQb8NhINdgYY73EcaB2PMvW94utq00gaUbqG_rZtWuHbj2tGoqR1Ep8hyTfn2M3Gsjjb_Tp-Ub88UGj-5Wo8i2oeAWcB8nuctlHhlAmaK8lUEzOVIuV6QqqMsYK6ZsTqfoiTeXX3LN2GWyVu50jMFKhdTqfJMAaOsSW4cuTj514k8U_ZWPh2Gg1Msjg8BM2b5eOhvv17rF9HO6clWtP__dxmms3ynfDR5ssfJ3nMZjOjUHpD9nx31nw_4nOB3AAAA__8nG572), not ego. Her coach praised her toughness and drive, even studying men's results in her age group to push herself harder. Race organizers called her "an icon of endurance," demonstrating that determination doesn't fade with age. [Watch a video of Natalie](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0L1q8zAUxvGrkbeYI8my4kHDCy8ZCiltoe0ojq0jW0UfqaPE-O5Legtdnwd-w__zbM8YYsjzMyYyfva2-mIzbddItdJqw1pywjyvmF3COWCuCSOmmxUg1IHDgWvrMMTdqsYZTyRINmS47kFLAaCbxQBXA_YTOA_DpLk4SidVr7zi_ugF8iaYh8aBawFcCtWOngOO3TB2NHCSPeuAXKhlbb9KyHUhH_dyp7WdSmqiWWq9XJn8x8SJidO2be1ebvU20uN_LFinhcnTncn_2_FNfLzsr99P781q3GULMYZrr1kHc8IQf8n65xZ3I34CAAD__7Sfc84).
## Teacher's Promise Comes Full Circle
In 2007, [kindergartner Calyssa Longoria](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLuOpDAQAL8GMo9s8zAEDi6ZbC69EDW4DX3jBzINs_P3q9lf2LikUqn-PaYHUKC0_oWI1q9-Yp-nhK8jIDOWiUpOEdJaILkIK0HiCAHiOWmpO6GkUGZyQOE9dbWzHlFjU6NVppem0VKaerPSzXPrZ2PaAQY3umUwvW7Vonqz-L5rarIfm5LKaKka3d1mryTM7Ti3OCps-qqV6Ihzuf3PlHhDH975wnJbcqyD3Zj3o2r-VPpe6fuOeQ_4QZW-rwXcCYyi4JmI8RAv4k0wwrJhEeAZi3hSclhWKIxJ7CVHOlBQEhcVCILpyfkp8GsJ50EXCqUGNfaNqYt1-4tCoKM3VSvXCBR-kvjXLy-rvwMAAP__YO-NAg) walked across a tiny stage with tears in her eyes as her teacher, Ms. Mikako Fisher Hill, promised to cheer her on again at high school graduation. Life took Calyssa down a longer road--through early motherhood, college, and now graduate school--but she never forgot that promise. [When they finally reconnected](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0D2OpDAUBODTQGbkH4xF4GCTznrTDa0Hfgbv-AeZ193i9iPmCpOWPpVK9e_pnhBTLNtfyGjDFhyF6gp-zoRE2FxstWQoW4PiM2wRCmVIkF9OcqmZ4EwY5yGmy-ne24AoUfVohZm4UZJz0-92XCRq71fttdSj9iBnNGZVxoDSy6z7aO82wYWRXCiphyUIDss4LyPOAtXUjRx9pNqG_zUW2jGkq76xDWvNfbI70XF26k8nH518nGutx_A6PrXRft3kDndkob6KZ6G2jI0RwrpjYxAIGxMTuxDayagywpTY7b_wIHabo9UcT-yb9ccnphTPyXQj3zLE9DOBfv3d28rvAAAA__-SgYdG) through an old photo shared on TikTok, both were surprised to learn that their paths had mirrored each other: each had attended UC Davis, become a young mother, and balanced parenting with school. Now a school administrator, Ms. Fisher called the reunion deeply meaningful._ "If I've made a difference in even one child's life,"_ she said, _" that's enough."_ ☺️ _Listen to an interview with Calyssa on this week's episode of [The Feel Good Flyover Podcast](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0L1u2zAUxfGnoTYL5CVFVgOHAoaX1t2KBFmIS-lKYsIPQ6Ks-O0D5xWyngP8hv_L1V0xxJDnf5jITvPk6lRcpmOLVCutLqwlJ8zzinlMOAfMNWHEtDvg0J0EPwnjRgzx4bpmtBMRkGzICqO5kcC5aRYrvPaDJhiVUdxz1REK9WsQXS96LTk0wT41wYUBLiR0rZ8ER696r6gXJDVTnMZQy9q-l5DrQlN8lDut7VBSE-1S621j8jeDC4PLcRzto-x19_T8nwvWYWHycmfy_Pbx53gN-1_6_M9AVybPoMzWrHa8HSHGsGnDFJ8Thvit1x9nuVv4CgAA__9R23bH). _🎧
## Meet Mal, the 180-Pound Gentle Giant Dog
More Shetland pony than sled dog, a [180-pound Malamute](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0D3uozAQQPHTQAcajw0OhYtt6LLtlmiAASbrj8g4Qbn9KnuFf_2kX_H-3Kc7iZe4_6bAbtu3qWxpinydnkvhPElOMVDcM8U10C4USyBP4TUhYNcoaJSdVhL_mbp6dRszsq7ZKduD1Qhg68MpayyuBArnAWbsF4Ns9MB6Nbdl6Lpa3FdToCyC0ti186aAZjPMhgfFuq8M8Col5faRJJaDN_9Jb87tkkLt3VHK86z0rwrHCsfrulpK_tsqHCkXWTyfFY6P11mav_wszZ7TJXFvvGzcKN1Ap27QDWZojxJ8nd36vMR7OXtbGdgDyX-uLj9-9Hb4LwAA__96s3te) named Mal wasn't quite the typical pup his owner had in mind. Now five years old, he's become [a local celebrity](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LFOwzAQgOGncbZG53Nik8EDAmVAKoKJMbrU59TIdiLHNOrbo_IK7L--4f86T2cKMeTlnRJbv_ip-nXKfOyRa-UyhbLmRHkplF2iJVCuiSKlnwkB-5OEkzSToxDvU98465mRVcNWGg1GIYBprhbk_DQoHrTX3kFnGFx30UbNiP1Fo2qCfWgSpEGQCvt29hJo7oa540Gy0qIDdqGupf1eQ65X9vG-3ri0lzU10V5r3XahngWOAsfjONqQ90pLofQoBI6bwPH146h6_nxJ25vAsSnWbUeIMezaiA6WRCH-efXfI24WfwMAAP__TxJyjw) in Bourne, England, known for his massive size and stubborn charm. Originally bred for pulling heavy loads in the Arctic, Mal's thick coat and sheer strength have made everyday tasks, like grooming or walking, a full-on production. Still, owner Amy Sharp calls him her "gentle giant" and says life with Mal is worth every tumbleweed of fur.

A man who served for 37 years felt he had no place in the military he gave his life to. It’s another sign of how absolutely shameful and horrific this moment is for our country.
#
Peter —
Yesterday, the commander of U.S. Southern Command resigned.
No one knows why, exactly, this commander resigned. But Combatant Commanders do not usually resign in the middle of their post — and especially in the middle of ongoing operations. It is a highly abnormal occurrence.
So, after watching the finest Military in the world be degraded, insulted, and abused for the last ten months, and after unprecedented attacks on the Constitution that he swore an oath to support and defend, possibly even after receiving illegal orders... he’d had enough.
Whatever the reason, a man who served for 37 years felt he had no place in the military he gave his life to. It’s another sign of how absolutely shameful and horrific Donald Trump’s so-called leadership is for our country. It makes us sick.
Still, there is a reason to hope. We’re hopeful because there are people in this country, like him, willing to do the right thing — even at the cost of everything they’ve worked towards for their entire lives. America is still here, and you can still be proud of that — even after everything Trump’s done.
Pride alone is not enough, though. To make it through this terrible moment, we have to put the right leaders in the right places. That is the entire mission of VoteVets — to get Veterans elected when no one else could win.
That mission is more important than ever, and we’re depending on your support to hit our goals and keep the work going.
So, if you’re sick and tired of this, please:

Why is Denver trying to buy Western Slope school boards?
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hi friends,
Check out today's Mountain Minute podcast [here](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), or watch on [YouTube](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) or [Rumble](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)!
🚨 ICYMI, we launched the **Douglas County Dirty Dozen** yesterday... EXPLICIT books. Graphic content. Zero oversight. Why are radical union-backed school board members defending sexually explicit material for 12-year-olds? Video #1 in the Douglas County Dirty Dozen series is here—and you won’t believe what’s on the shelves. Follow along on [X](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), [Instagram](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), [Facebook](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) & [TikTok](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)!
Here is a summary of today's top stories:
🏔️ **Here in Colorado...** Governor Jared Polis is [rethinking the state’s sweeping AI law](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) after business leaders warned it could crush innovation, while Aurora officials are [defying his housing mandates](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), calling them an assault on local zoning and property rights. In Jefferson County, police arrested a Ralston Valley High School student for [threatening violence](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) just shortly after the Evergreen tragedy, reigniting safety concerns in schools. Fiscal critics are blasting state leaders for [crying “budget crisis”](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) while pouring millions into EV rebates, and election season battles are heating up [as voters weigh Propositions LL and MM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)—measures that could gut TABOR refunds and expand bureaucratic control over education.
Meanwhile, Denver faces scrutiny for allegedly trying to [“buy influence” over rural school boards](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), and the Western Slope reflects on [how the La Plata River shaped modern water law](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). Adding a dramatic turn, former Mesa County Clerk Tina Peters returned to federal court this week, where a judge heard arguments on whether Colorado’s denial of her bond pending appeal violated her constitutional rights. Peters’ legal team described [two possible “doors” to her release](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) as the court took her habeas corpus petition under advisement.
**🇺🇸 On the National Stage...** A new study finds a sharp cultural shift among young Americans, with [trans and “queer” identities falling from 7% to under 4% since 2023](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). Analysts say cultural fatigue and changing social norms are driving the decline, signaling what many see as the end of identity politics’ dominance on college campuses.
This is the Mountain Minute for Friday, October 17, 2025.
– Team RMV
---
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[Why is Denver trying to buy Western Slope school boards?](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY CHRISTY ANDERSON, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_In the Grand Junction area you may have seen flyers in your mailbox accusing our current school board members, Andrea Haitz, Angela Lema and “Willie” (Will) Jones of being “enemies” who “cannot be trusted.” These false attack ads come from Denver’s “Students Deserve Better” campaign. After digging into the financials, Students Deserve Better is also majorly funded by none other than the Colorado Education Association._
_The teachers union has a long history that started in the 1970s of using money to influence local elections, but this year’s spending is unprecedented. The Colorado Education Association (CEA) is pouring tens of thousands of dollars into our local school board race to regain control and push their highly partisan and politically left National Education Association handbook, not to support what is best for students, families or teachers of our district._

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Two doors and an insurance policy: Inside the legal backstops in Tina Peters’ October 16 hearing](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY JEN SCHUMANN, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Former Mesa County Clerk Tina Peters appeared in federal court on October 16 for a motions hearing tied to her habeas corpus petition, which argues that Colorado violated her constitutional rights by denying bond pending appeal.
* Judge Varholak struck witness testimony alleging Dominion software vulnerabilities and Smartmatic ties but accepted an amicus brief from over 3,000 citizens claiming Peters’ case reflects a broader pattern of punishing political speech through bail decisions.
* Peters’ defense outlined two potential “doors” to her release if the writ is granted—one granting immediate freedom under her original bond, and another requiring a new federal bond—while the court took the case under advisement for a written ruling.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|

**[Young Americans are dropping trans and queer labels, study finds sharp cultural shift](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE WESTERN JOURNAL](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* A new report from the Centre for Heterodox Social Science shows trans and “queer” identification among young Americans has sharply declined after peaking in 2023, dropping from nearly 7% of college students to under 4% today.

* The study found that incoming freshmen are even less likely to identify as LGBTQ+, suggesting the downward trend will continue, while gay and lesbian identification has remained stable.

* Researchers attribute the shift to changing cultural norms and “identity fatigue,” with many students abandoning newer, non-conforming sexual labels that surged in popularity during the 2010s and early 2020s.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
** ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️ **
**[The County That Said No](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**BY SEAN POND | COMMENTARY | OCTOBER 17** _There are moments in history when ordinary people must decide if they will remain silent or rise up. If they will be ruled or govern themselves. If they will allow outsiders to rewrite their way of life, or if they will draw a line and say, “This far, and no further.”_
**[A small river with big influence: How the La Plata shaped western water law](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY STEVE HARRIS | COMMENTARY | OCTOBER 16** _The La Plata River Compact is also over 100 years old. It was negotiated between Delph Carpenter from Colorado and Stephen Davis from New Mexico during 1922 and finalized at Bishop’s Lodge in Santa Fe, New Mexico. I could not find minutes or detailed information on the negotiations between Carpenter and Davis and so relied upon information in Daniel Tyler’s biography of Carpenter titled Silver Fox of the Rockies._
**[Results speak for themselves: The D51 school board has earned re-election](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY KENT ZOOK | COMMENTARY | OCTOBER 15** _I am writing to express my support for Andrea Haitz (District C), Will Jones (District D), and Angela Lema (District E), who are seeking re-election to the District 51 School Board. I voted for them because we needed a huge change, and their work since taking office has exceeded my expectations. They’ve made significant improvements that deserve to continue._

**💊 DID YOU KNOW?** **Penicillin was originally called “mold juice."** In 1928, bacteriologist Alexander Fleming accidentally discovered penicillin after leaving a petri dish out while on vacation. When he returned, he found mold growing in it—and noticed the bacteria around the mold had died. Before giving his discovery its famous name, he simply called it “mold juice,” not realizing he’d just found the world’s first antibiotic.

**[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/117486156/576638513/-309737922?refcode=251017_RG_shutdown-pet-rs&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTcxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxZTY2MmQyZi05OGFiLWYwMTEtOGU2MS02MDQ1YmRlZDhiYTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=XeCB7O1wgAcCNYmZR5EpECQKPlgca5CfXwNraeXTDXw=)**
Hi, it’s Congressman Robert Garcia here with an urgent request.
The government is shut down, and the damage to our country is real — to federal workers, community services, and programs that so many families depend on.
But that’s not all. We’re now seeing Donald Trump use the federal government to weaponize that pain — blaming Democrats publicly through partisan messages and websites.
**That’s not just wrong — it’s likely illegal under the Hatch Act. And I’m calling for a full investigation into these violations.**
**[But I need to know where you stand, so let me know: Do you support Democrats investigating Trump’s lawless administration and working to hold him accountable for his abuses of power?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/117486157/576638514/-1512507916?refcode=251017_RG_shutdown-pet-rs&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTcxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxZTY2MmQyZi05OGFiLWYwMTEtOGU2MS02MDQ1YmRlZDhiYTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=XeCB7O1wgAcCNYmZR5EpECQKPlgca5CfXwNraeXTDXw=&emci=ed6b104e-01ab-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&emdi=1e662d2f-98ab-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&ceid=16877361)**

The State Party will provide the most important facts - a kernel of truth - from the week. = ** Republican Corruption Continues Unchecked at All Levels of Indiana Two massive local corruption scandals have rocked Indiana Republicans in recent weeks. In Johnson County, a countywide elected official is accused of stalking a minor, and in Dearborn County, a city councilman is accused of stealing over $125K from a local civic club. The Republican Johnson County Coroner is facing over a dozen charges for stalking and offering drugs and alcohol to an underaged girl. He was arrested this week on those charges, and has still not resigned his position. In Dearborn County, a Greendale city councilman is accused of stealing over $125K from the Dillsboro Civic Club to pay for vacations, travel, campaign expenses, and personal expenses. After 21+ years of one-party rule, Indiana Republicans really think they can get away with anything. Trump Calls Indiana Republicans to Push Redistricting While Government Stays Shutdown The federal government is entering its third-straight week of government shutdown, but the President of the United States seems less than focused on solving that issue, and instead is calling legislators here in Indiana to push his mid-decade gerrymandering scheme alive. Reporting from today showed that President Trump called members of the Indiana Senate Republican Caucus on Friday to personally push for redistricting. He cares more about his own power than about the paychecks of thousands of Hoosier families that have been stopped during this shutdown. Call your State Senator today and make sure they hear from an actual Hoosier: (317) 232-9400. Frank Mrvan knows that supporting steel and family farms are national security issues that help make up the backbone of our country. He’s doing everything he can to keep export markets open for our farmers, and reopen the markets that have been closed by Donald Trump and his backward administration. He knows that our family farmers deserve better than the $40 billion bailout the Trump administration is giving to Argentina on the backs of Hoosier farmers. Congressman Mrvan will work hard to open up the markets that help our farmers make ends meet, and expand opportunities for rural communities across Northwest Indiana and the whole state.
